text: Sure, it's free to play, but you'll definitely need to pay to progress. After a few months of playing and spending way too much in the game, I'm again stuck at a point where I can't progress in the game unless I spend, AGAIN. The more you spend, the more difficult the levels. There are too few "freebies" to help you finally get past hurdles. Such a shame, because the game is pretty entertaining *when* you can actually play. I'll be deleting after the current team event. I'm done wasting money.

This USED to be my favourite game and I would spend at least a couple of hours every day playing on it. BUT the creators have changed it so much now that levels and bonuses are impossible to attain without spending money! I'm so disappointed - what used to be fun is now too difficult to play. Many team mates have already left and I'll be bowing out soon too.

Very disappointed with Royal Match. The adverts are completely misleading. I downloaded the game thinking it was all about saving the king from danger, solving rescue puzzles, and escaping traps - exactly like the ads show. In reality, it’s mostly just another boring match game where you build a castle. The actual “save the king” levels are very rare and nothing like what is constantly advertised. Feels like false advertising just to get people to download it.

It used to be a lot more fun but now most of the levels are difficult (or extremely difficult) even when it's supposed to be a regular challenge. It is heavily skewed to push for players to spend money. Coins earned for clearing a level average about 50. It costs 900 to keep trying a failed level without restarting, so the rewards are paltry at best.

I was on level 3800 and they were way too hard to get through without consistently spending money, it became an addiction almost, one more move to get you on to the next level after hours of trying. They sure know how to get you hooked to keep buying to get you through levels. Played it for 18 months but have uninstalled it after my own experience and reading lots of similar negative reviews.

The game was great to start with and have been playing for 2 years. However the levels are getting difficult which requires spending money. This is frustrating and I will stop playing if this carries on as its no longer enjoyable anymore. Please make it convienant for everyone. Sometimes I am stuck on the same levels for days. The prices have gone up to purchase coins as well which becomes unfair. Its great the game is doing well but please make it accessible for everyone as eventually wont play

When you get to the top level you get put in a league, which will progress well up until a point where you will get gate keeped, and won't be able to progress unless the game gives you the right combination of power ups, so can be stuck doing a level or two if you are lucky some days. You can pay to help yourself out but that will only help you for a level or two before you get stuck again, making paying worthless. the game is fun for a while then it's just not anymore

fun but at a Cost... at a certain point it becomes unachievable to complete levels without either the stars aligning or putting money into power ups or extra turns. your gold will dwindle and you'll spend days stuck on the same level. it's fun for the early game but when you get to the point that you're struggling to progress, save some money and leave, it doesn't get better!

Dear game developers I understand that the game has become very popular as time past, but as a person that I've been playing the game for 4 years I think I can say that the game is slowly downgrading. The team that I am currently in and myself have been spending quite an amount of money but that has come to an end. While putting new levels you just made them harder and the reward sistem is absolutely ridiculous. I hope that you consider some improvements before you lose players.

really good fun game. collecting the gold cards can be annoying though, I collected every card but 1 with 23 days left, despite getting hundreds of cards after I still didn't get the missing card, you can't request it, you can't select your own cards, you can't buy it with your coins, you just hope that you'll get it. I never did, then the cards to collect changed, and we all had to start again, fix this problem, and it's a 5 * game.

I uninstalled this game in December 2024 because it felt like a money grab. I tried it again after more than a year, but nothing has changed. After purchasing, chain reactions suddenly happen everywhere and winning becomes very easy. Later the game turns extremely difficult again unless you spend more money. Rewards are also getting smaller and stingier. Because of this pattern, I’m uninstalling again.

Have been playing this game for a long time but now it is unplayable. Black blotches all over the screen, pixilating. Can't read in game messages. Royal Kingdom works fine, so annoying as my placing is quite high. Have uninstall and reinstalled, forced stop and regularly clear my cache every day. Nothing works. Either there is a glitch or it was a bad update. Anyone else having this problem?.

It's fine, plenty of challenge (a level might take a week to beat, or even longer, unless you're willing to spend in-game currency on continues and power-ups). The only thing that truly upsets me is that the "refill lives for coins" option is hidden under the quit option, so if I click through the quit button too quickly, it charges me in-game currency *I did not want to spend* to refill lives *I did not want to use*. It's the only part of the game that truly feels scammy and exploitative.

Fun! No wifi needed. The main match 3 game is fun, and having a few side game options keeps things interesting. Many match 3 games are too challenging, and you end up frustrated because you have to spend all your resources just simply trying to get through the levels. This game isn't like that. (So far. I'm level 386). My only criticism is that I wish the room decorating part was more interactive. Like giving choices of different decor to use.

Meh. It was fun. Puzzle 1-800 and easy and fun enough. After puzzle 800 they all get a bit more challenging. After puzzl3 1000, good luck. I had a 793 puzzle winning streak from puzzle 1-800. Now I'm lucky to be able to win 1 maybe 2 puzzle a day. Some days I'm stuck on a puzzle for days. I don't spent money on games. Not much fun when you can't beat a puzzle for days. Was looking for a game to pass my down time, not stress me out.

The game is fun, and the first 200 levels are relatively easy, and there are no ads (which is a blessing!!)... you get rewarded for clearing a level on the first try... the issue starts after level 200 when it becomes a "pay to win" game, where the only way to clear a level is to use booster of a kind (and they run out fast).. i understand the developers need to make money, but making a game unplayable after a certain level is just bad UX practice.

I've been playing this game for years & reached the Royal League quite some time ago. I loved the challenging levels. BUT Suddenly the game took a ridiculous turn to "impossible unless you spend money". Once you finally give in and spend a couple $ it gives you a fighting chance until becoming impossible without spending again. QUITTING. UNINSTALLING.

Fun until you reach the point where every level is nearly impossible to pass because it's trying to force you to spend money. When you're no longer winning consistently, you don't build up boosters or coins anymore, and you have to constantly wait for lives to refill - unless you pay for all that in real-world money. Just a cash grab at the end of the day. Eventually becomes too infuriating to play. I'd rather it have ads and actually be playable without spending money to be honest.

I'm currently on level 669, and I thought I'm going to look at the reviews on this game to see if others are getting as frustrated as me.. well I wasn't wrong. as soon as you get superhighway ball. it just screws you and if your not willing to pay money on a free game you can't win or not very easily at that. probably stop playing it again, it was a pass time now I just get mad with it

False advertising like all these games. Played for several hours to give it a shot. Made it all the way to the pool area which is fairly far in I think and I can count on maybe two hands the amount of games that they advertise in the video. Almost all of them were the same exact scenario as well.

Came pre- installed on the phone. After seeing tons of ads I tried the installed version. Fun game so far, nothing intrusive to affect game play. At least not at these levels. No forced pay to play either. So an enjoyable time sink so far. There is a limit to the number of loves allowed per level, which adds difficulty, and then there are modifiers - things that only break a certain way that you need to take care of. Game play is also pretty much what the ads show, which is nice.

So far this game doesn't have the areas that I've seen in the video advertisements in other games, which is somewhat disappointing. That's why I installed this game. It seems to work okay without an internet connection and with a low cell phone signal, which is a very good thing in my opinion and which might influence me to keep the game.

The game punishes you for not spending money after awhile. I run a clan with another teammate, we're in the higher levels of the game, and all of the optional games for little power ups and cosmetic items have all of a sudden become near impossible to get. The only members of our team to get them are the ones who pay for the pass. If you pair with those players, suddenly you can easily win on those games, but will be near impossible with anyone else. We're about to uninstall.

The game is fun. I enjoy playing this. except for 1 event game mode. the Championship Clash. It feels like your fighting a battle you never meant to win. Your oponents just keep throwing massive points at you unlimitedly. Like all their moves gives points. Its like they don't to setup and think for their next move. Ti think they advertise this as a live oponent. Stupid algorithem. It's annoying.

I am getting more and more frustrated with this game. If I close the game, with or without moves left, no matter if I open it back up immediately or take a little bit to open it back up, it always starts my level over. Leaving me losing all my rockets, tnt barrels, and super balls along with the number of plays I had left. So I have to start at zero and recollect 10 balls to get my super ball back.

something has changed. I don't know if it's new management, but it is not good like it used to be. now the money hungry management has made it so you waste your power-ups and coins faster so you can buy more more-often. newsflash, people will always spend money on it. I figured it out quickly, so when I run out of power-ups, I will delete the game. it's unfortunate too, because it used to be the best game on the play store. if I recognize a better change before I run out, I'll keep it.

I loved playing in the beginning. But now I realize it's just a money grab. maybe I have been foolish this whole time thinking it was straight up. However, whenever I start to build some momentum, it thwarts it with several difficult puzzles requiring I use all my tokens and special items. Way too many times, I have been left with one item to clear. The damn propeller always goes after the wrong thing, misaligning other things I have previously set up. The fix is in. I will never pay for it!

I'm over level 12,000. There was a time when the game was fun, especially with the team I led. However, gameplay is constantly interrupted by numerous simultaneous mini games. It is now inundated with tasks and progress feedbacks to the point that it's no longer enjoyable (app is 1.7 GB & growing). All these interruptions feel like pop-ups. You also can't complete card sets without spending money. Like others have said, you can be one card away from completion for a month and still not get it.

This was once fun, and it certainly does have a community factor in the groups, which is a positive. However, game play changed dramatically and it became exceedingly difficult to make it through a round without paying ridiculous amounts--which often aren't honored. As a result, I uninstalled it, though I imagine they won't miss the money much.

I appreciate the fact that the developers spent time on the sound effects, for me the little things count! THe game obviously gets more difficult the higher you get but if you don't allow yourself to get overwhelmed you can figure out where to attack to win. My favorite part is rescuing the King. It's timed so there's some pressure but just concentrate where you need to go and you can always bounce between goals to catch the best moves. Now, if I could take my own advice!! It's a great game!

not fun when you're not winning. there's no ads, so that's nice; lots of competition, but the higher the level the less you win, and when you're out of lives, it takes half an hour to wait for another life. I've been on the same game without moving forward for 3 days now, and this happens more often than not. it doesn't help to use boosters, it seems to annoy the algorithm and creates too many wasted moves. UNINSTALLING

This game is fun when I can actually play. Some of the levels are so hard, almost impossible to beat, that it becomes more frustrating than fun. I am considering deleting this app. Also, many of the screenshots shown on the advertisement are not really how this game is, they are false. I uninstalled this and Royal Kingdom. it became too difficult and frustrating to beat levels without purchasing help. it's not fun anymore.

Good time passer, though only briefly. I started playing this game last spring or summer - it was great. Team play was amazing and it was easy to win side games and complete sets and tasks. It was easy to veg out and play for an hour or so. These things are nearly impossible now. You rarely hit a win streak, and can never keep your Super Light Ball more than 2 levels. If you complete all your tasks or sets, you're either extremely lucky or have paid a good amount of money. AVOID OR DELETE!

I used to love this game and have been playing it for almost 3 years now. I have occasionally spent money on it as well. in the last few months though they have made changes that make it not as enjoyable. I'm now often stuck on a level for several days at a time, im not able to complete individual or team quests anymore, and the couple of times ive spent money to continue my streak, it lost again in a couple of levels. This seems to have started when they introduced the "extremely hard" level

the game is fun until you start to notice that every time you win the light ball, or you have a chance at earning something cool, the game all of the sudden becomes super impossible even though they list it as an easy level. And the way the colors drop you see that you're going to get a 5 in a row, but no, you only get 3 away before the colors finish dropping.

The ads that show saving the king are not what the game really is as that feature only happens occasionally so that's misleading. What it really is is a certain number of moves to complete each level by matching the jewels. About one in four levels are impossible to complete without having to spend money. You just always run out of moves and it then offers options to continue for more money.

Definitely a Gacha matching game. Levels do start easy, hard then very hard throughout. After a bit it requires you to spend money for in game powers or to give yourself a few more moves to use to keep your butler buffs (because it's not enough) After spending a week on just 1 level, I'm done with it entirely. Majority of the matching boards are randomly generated and never helps the player. No matter what tactics you use, it is a different each time with what to match first and what falls next.

This game has become trash and unplayable. The creators are going to push themselves out of the market because of greed. The levels have become too difficult. It's started as a fun way to relax game to being too difficult to play so you can buy moves to move to the next round. Some levels can literally take you days to finish or until you get fed up and decide to pay to move on. The whole idea for the programming, Spend more money, make us richer..

Very enjoyable game.. But after someone loses on the same level for a bunch of times, it does get frustrating.. Maybe give some free moves at the end, especially if someone is stuck on the same level for a long time and after tens of failed attempts.. I've seen my friends delete the game especially in the hard levels when they get stuck and couldn't get out after tens and even hundreds of attempts.. Continued and eventual progression in a game is what keeps people interested.. Just a suggestion.

The game is very heavily designed around gambling-like algorithms. Sometimes you can’t pass certain levels even after 10 tries — the game simply doesn’t let you progress easily and waits for you to maybe spend some money. If there’s no spending, it eventually lets you pass the level, and then the cycle repeats. Quite often the game glitches, and matching 4 or 5 identical pieces does nothing. It also frequently bugs out and takes coins for a new life without continuing the current game. Also, wh

You will automatically win games when you first install it. A hard level may be accomplished after 5 or 6 rounds. Then, the levels will become ridiculously hard to win. You will start getting less moves as the levels become harder. Not much fun to play, so don't waste your time downloading it. (OAN?) When I deleted this game? Several months later? It was automatically downloaded back on my phone 🤔 Now I'm wondering if these people are "Hacker" 😡

started the game when it was much more playable. now it's rigged to the core to force you to spend resources nearly every level. To give you perspective on how it became obviously rigged. 1. shooters combo shoots in wrong direction about 75% of the time. 2. generates bombs frequently to screw your combo build up. 3. it randomly opens with sudden pop-up ad that if you accidentally press, 9900 gold will be gone for some double point trash deal. 4. the power-up rewards are no longer permenant.

My last review in 2023 was a 5*. I have been playing this game for last 3 years. It was a stress buster. Easy levels, lots of power ups and coins etc. But lately, the rewards have been cut to less than half. The levels don't clear easily. It's become tough. It has started giving stress now. Don't know for how long I'll keep this game.

waste, don't spend your money, it's built for you to spend too move forward. I pay regularly for the app but for the card event, they rarely give me the full 135 cards, before the event ends. I played it and got a set only once,. I'm on the 6th one, I spend too much to not win the card game. at least on time, damn its about 60 days...... and yet they don't give you all them.... they responded to me that they couldn't do much, I have the screen shot.

Can be a lot of fun. However, it requires that you constantly need to buy coins in order to win.. The algorithms are sometimes not real friendly. Some levels cannot be won without buying coins. If you choose not to keep dumping money, it could take 15-20 lives before they let you win. since you get a life every 30 minutes, I have played on one level an entire day.

I’ve been playing Royal Match for 2 months, and as a developer, it feels highly manipulated. Levels suddenly become very hard, then later turn easy. Helpful items appear only in the last moves. I spent time completing a collection for 25k coins, was just 3 cards away, but after an update, everything reset. Honestly, it feels designed to waste your time and push you toward spending money unnecessarily. Also, most 5-star ratings feel useless and not honest.

I used to play this came alot in 2021, it was awesome back then just really addictive. Fast forward to 2025 when I reinstalled. The game changed completely, levels became much harder, the power ups lost it's value. Back then, you could used the shuffle power up and it made sense, now you have to use it 3 times before it actually work in your favour. The rewards are weak and I realised the game will actually sabotage you. If you're winning too much, the game will cheat you and force you to spend.

You know, this rating used to be 5 stars. This was an amazing game to simply wind down at the end of a long day. But some kind of recent update has upped the difficulty to 11. After personally playing 13,000 levels? Only NOW has it become virtually impossible to play without purchasing power ups. I will now fail a level 6 or 7 times in a row before moving up to the next level. Then the process repeats. You'll get your 5 stars back when you return this to casual play and not pay to play.

I've been playing for years. Just casual playing. Hit level 1000 tonight and thought... it's a good time to leave a review! I love how easy it is to play this game. I'm a senior (69) and when I have to wait for something, appt, a table, etc... This game opens in seconds, play is quick, no internet, no annoying ads (there are ads, just not horribly annoying ads!), I personally don't spend money but you can if you want to! At level 1000 and I still enjoy it. Definitely a 10 out of 10!

ready to delete this game. I'm on level 10,988! I've been playing for a long time. every level at this point is hard or as they have now Extremely Hard. it's hard to advance to the next level plus no one will give you help with an extra life. NO ONE! I think it's because no one plays it any more. Royal Kingdom is better. This has become too tiring. playing for days with no next level in sight. Bye Bye! FTS!

I like the game but there is a flaw with the double board levels. Example you try to combine light ball with tnt it will not do it 50% of the time. instead the light ball will choose a color. this happens on my table or on my phone. I don't know if the programmers did this on purpose. I would like to see this fixed but there is no support button in the app. hopefully they read their reviews.

Unfair rewards in Puzzle Match. Step 2 is a 9 piece puzzle, while step 9 is a 36 piece puzzle and the "reward" given for completing both steps is exactly the same, a single measly light ball booster. They took away the 2x booster from Butler's Gift, they now want you to pay for it! Rewards continue to decrease while you have to play more to get the smaller rewards. The developers keep finding ways to make this game more unfair and a total waste of your time. Total money grab, do not even bother.

when Im in a game and run out of moves. I need to transfer funds to buy extra moves. I'll leave the app open during the transfer and when I go back I'm at the main menu. I've spent sooo much money on this app for that. you guys seriously need to fix that bug because it's really not worth playing if that's going to continue happening

This game is just pure fun. A simple preimse that kills time. The colors are bright and relaxing. The game doesn't require too much thinking which is great. The nightmare levels are fun and give you a good challenge. I highly recommend this game. This is a casual game so if you want a more challenging game go somewhere else but this game is great for everyone.

No lie it's ADDICTIVE and PLAY at your own risk!!! At first I came for the game board that they displayed in the commercials. I was disappointed when they never really matched what was displayed. As I continued to play and joined a team then it became a different experience. Then when I created a team that works together the experience evolved even more!

I wish I could give them minus stars. I'm so sick of playing the same level for 5 days or more. I'm way up near level 4,000 & I've tried every scenario to beat the level & I don't have any implements to use. The game has made me extremely mad & I'm not sure if I want to keep playing it unless the the developer reaches out to me. It used to be that you could ask them if there's a way to beat the level & you don't get that. I flat refuse to waste money on a game, too. 😡

It starts off great, but later game difficulty gets a little ridiculous. There's an objective to each level and a limited amount of moves are allowed. I've reached a point where 20 moves is all I get to take out 127 objects with limited space. Not sure how to beat levels like that without paying or waiting weeks on end.

Level 10339!!!!! Since the last update to the game in June, 2026: things have gotten weird. It tells me I've got a free 30 minute play but nothing transpires. I'm just so glad that I've never paid real money. The EXTREMELY HARD levels are STILL slowing the gameplay down to a crawl! All in all, the whole freaking game has gotten very difficult to enjoy anymore.

fun game until you get to the higher levels then you can't catch a break. You don't get anything to work with and it's impossible to earn anything. You just end up losing everything and then play the next level 30-50 times . You finally get bast it and the next level states extremely hard. Just greed they want you to spend money.

Amazing game! Match 3 is so addicting, and getting to build a castle with it is great! The gimmicks? En pointe! I just wish it could be played without WiFi. Edit: so, now it's offline again! Before you couldn't do any events offline - not a single one! - and now it's been reversed back to the way it was. Much better, Dream Games!

Although this is a free game it does lock you out of advancing if you run out of lives unless you have enough coins to continue. You can buy more coins with real money or wait for a while for your lives to fill back up. You can replay levels if you have coins otherwise there are penalties to replay the levels such as a losing a lot of your power ups. You can buy power ups with real money. So, similar to all games, they count on micro transactions which is why I only gave it 3 stars.

It's an interesting game but the developers should pls try to include new cards in every card pack because I noticed when one is almost close to completing a set, new cards don't appear again especially when the set is almost expiring. So after collecting 125 cards from the beginning of the collection you will miss the reward for the set completion because they don't add new sets to the cards once the collection is about to end.

A sinister ripoff of Candy Crush. Lures you in until you've played maybe 5 rounds, then increases the difficulty to take your lives. If you don't play for a few days, the difficulty drops until you're back and playing again. The game seems to be setup to intentionally create addiction. I noticed it would play in my mind after I played for a few days, causing me to see the stupid shapes when I'd close my eyes or try to think about other things I need to do in life. The terms follow this issue.

I wish I could give this 5 stars. It would be so fun and addictive but instead it's just frustrating because so many of the levels require extra moves to beat, which you have to buy. It would be fine if a few here and there were too hard to beat without extra moves and power ups, but it's nearly all so it really just takes the fun out of it. I'm probably going to delete soon and find another easier match game.

the game is usually very fun however when there are competitions, it will NOT allow you to complete a certain level unless you spend money. once the tournament is over then magically the level is easy to finish. I played 1 level for 1 week straight. I refused to spend money so the game didn't let me finish it. Of course after the tournament is over, I completed the level with moves to spare. It's not just this tournament, it's EVERY SINGLE ONE. Stop making it so easy to detect that your scamming

Seems like the more $'s I put into this game the more it jerks Me over. In several ways. I'm about ready to delete this game. If it wasn't for My teammates I would have deleted it a ling time ago. This is the 1st game I have ever gotten on a team. Also put thousands into it. After Design Home started Me over erasing years of playing and $'s spent all gone and totally ignored after several emails asking for help. These games seem to be just huge scams... Not enough enjoyment for the $'s spent.

Once you get to harder levels, you play the main game unsuccessfully for about 5 minutes and then lives are gone. Without winning the main game, you don't have whats needed to play the side games, which were fun when I actually got a chance to play. Without winning the main game, you also lose the chance to win coins and helpers, like bombs, propellers etc., so you can't win without the help , but you can't get the helps without winning. Same for the double mirror ball.

When I first started playing this game, it was fun and creative. Now, it is boring, really, really boring. Why, you ask? Just like all the other reviews, it changed into cash to play. They effectively reduced all the bonuses and added "Extremely Hard," which has the same payout as the "super hard" used to. Do not play this game unless you have lots of cash to pay to play. Even an average level. Boooo Royal Match. You are what's wrong with the world.. .greed

Such a bad game which has programmed all the steps. Make you spend money to pass each stage. A very bad and greedy merchant . Game is boring after you have higher score and difficult to pass each stage. I'll quit the game if there is no improvement.😡It is a money grap game which worth 4.5 star. If you want to release your stress and to have fun, DON'T play this game.

Has anyone else noticed how unfriendly the Royal Crown levels are? It honestly feels like if you don’t top up, the game just hard-locks your progress. I was stuck on Round 104 for no less than 50 attempts. I only managed to pass after filing a complaint and trying another 17 times afterwards. At this point, it’s honestly getting a little too excessive.

update 05/04/26 thank you for bringing back the Royal Pass! vs the weekly. back to 5 ⭐! Too costly with the weekly pass. This game is highly addictive and lots of fun to play. however they've gone from a $9.99 monthly pass which we could use our $5 off coupon for, to $7.99 a week! of course that's optional but if you want to advance in levels you're going to have to pay. I don't know that I'm going to be able to continue this game.

nice graphics....like the game....but these developers want you to pay money.....think the new royal cup part of the game is set up as a scam just to make you pay. Also in the top left corner it shows what you have to accompish to beat the game....usually this info is incorrect. The longer you play the more difficult to win. They want you to pay, pay, pay.

a great switch to basic line completion games. I never thought organizing shapes and trying to accomplish the game goals would occupy my attention but it's our lives in this new era of phones. Grateful for easy play, ui and the storyline. I just would like to know if higher levels can initiate some better prizes especially if you are not tapping your Gpay everyday. :)

Started playing in 2024. Very enjoyable, until about 3 months ago, when they drastically changed the difficulty of it, trying to get people to buy as many passes as possible to keep playing. Half our group quit. I'm now joining them. If you want something fun, this isn't it anymore.

It's a good game and I have a really good team mates fantastic and yes you can spend way to much money and I didn't realize how much I was spending and yes the higher the level the less you get you beat a super hard level and you get 50 coins which is crazy because you need 900 coins just to get extra levels. And the developers are billionaire

finally a game with no ads. awesome game. however update 6-30-26, I play countless levels and you make it impossible to collect all cards of any Collection! Proof I'm on level 8731, Collections Completed 8, n Sets Completed 216. I do the tournaments and all the side quests and you continue to give repeated cards that I've already collected. so now Ive reduced to leaving the quest alone because you're not going to win new cards and just play the game. Please rethink the routine of this. - 1 star
This is not a video game!!! It's life-wasting toxicity in the form of an app! And I can't believe people waste their money on this...PATHETIC!

When reaching the highest levels it becomes exactly like Candy Crush - where you need an exact sequence in order to pass. I can't even get boosters going because I lose them on the easiest levels! Losing on a regular level - and with boosters, is nuts. I quit CC because of this type of problem and I will quit Royal Match also if nothing changes. Loved the relaxing play, but now it is pure frustration. I can't earn the rewards because I can't even complete easy levels without being stopped!

If you collect a lot of coins, the game will try to make you spend them by making the puzzles almost impossible. If you still choose not to spend them to continue the puzzle or to buy new lives, it will just take them. I had well over 27,000 coins last night, and today, I have 17,000. I haven't made any erroneous purchases. It just stole them. Horrible Game!

It's fun for a while. The algorithm seems to really favor some players over others. For instance, I'll join the daily "competition" with players at the same level. I will fail the level for hours. The person I played against beat the level so soundly they managed to get 30000 points to my 500 and failing. This is a regular occurrence. "Super hard" means stuck for days. "Regular" means you may or may not get past it in a day. Obstacles become tedious instead of fun. It's a mediocre game.

Champion's Clash is a scam. They want you to try as hard as possible to win the Grand Final and use your power-ups against bots so you have to buy more (I'm not spending money on this game). No other complaints. I'm sure they'll eventually make the levels too hard to beat without buying power-ups, but that's nothing new with pay-to-win games.
