Pretty much title. I've been bombarded with ads for Royal Match when playing other free, ad-supported games, so it was only a matter of time until I downloaded it and played it. And it was good, but hit the point of annoyance like all free games that led me to uninstall it. Pros: It actually delivers on the special levels they include in the ads. You know the ones where they have you making a path for water to reach the sprinkler system to put out the fire, or match blocks to release a key bef

puzzles are fun but eventually forced to pay. you don't save the king all that often. it reminds me of every other puzzle game. it's no wifi, so that's a plus! also this games ads (the one for this game) are way too long. an ad i kept getting was over 2 minutes. not even playable. This is absolutely egregious. make it playable if it's gonna be that long.

I only installed it because of the ad. Saving the king from drowning by matching shapes is such a unique, cool concept and something I never seen before in a puzzle game. When I actually played the real thing however, I didn't get to do that. Just a generic matching game with some pointless castle customization. It's still somewhat enjoyable but nowhere near as fun as the ad.

It could be a funny and entertaining game, but: - many times, the success of the level depends on luck and absolutely not on the player's skill as the icons are generated procedurally. You can either end up with a lot of good combos or totally useless patterns, ending up wasting a lot of lives. - in a vast majority of cases, the game pushes the player's frustration level to use resources and power ups or, in the most unfortunate case, buy them with shameful micro transactions.

I love the game and played it for several years until I decided I'd spent way too much on a free game. While it is not impossible win without paying, when you've played a level for a week and you finally get within ONE move of beating it, it's very difficult not to buy more moves. And, yes, like the ads say, there are no ads in the game, but that means you can't watch one to get moves or other things.

Finally the pay to win puzzle game you've been waiting for!!! Want nearly impossible odds that can only be overcome if you spend money then you're in luck! Oh did you come to this game for the ads showing interesting puzzles to save the king? Well that's too bad. There are some but they are not like the ads and not really accessible. You complete puzzles to decorate the king's castle for some reason.... This is also completely on the rails with no choices available.

This game has turned into the total scam unfortunately. I have been playing it for the last 3 years but uninstalled it today. The game itself is ok, but be ready that there is a very little chance you'd be able to pass all the levels without paying. I don't mind paying and did, but I don't like when players are forced to do it in a scam manner. Moves disappear, matches sometimes don't work accordingly as many people have written here, algorithm specifically makes you to lose. Don't recommend.

This is an update to my previous 5 star rating. Once you pass level 5000, the game becomes so difficult that the only way to progress is to spend real money. also, when you finally win 10 levels and get the super light ball, the next level will be a very difficult on so you loose the ball immediately. When a game is so hard it is no longer fun, I am done with it. Games are for fun, not frustration. I will be deleteting for this reason.

You don't HAVE to pay to play and there's no ads to watch.... But there's a million animations you for every little thing, the levels stop being fun to play when it gets closer to level 1000, there's mini games that the game will intentionally make you fail, you'll get stuck playing the same level for a long time (sempiternal torture), and if you get power ups it basically forces you to use them.

🤑WARNING🤑: HIGHLY ADDICTIVE, you'll end up spending hundreds (Yes, $HUNDREDS$) just to keep playing. I usually avoid in-app paid games, but this one got me in their trap when I was at a low point. It is an enjoyable game, but you'll end up spending a couple of dollars, then maybe just 1 bundle pack ("to save money"), then, before you know it, you've spent $100's. I strongly feel that this type of game SHOULD BE BANNED😨🤑! I'd pay to purchase it, but without having to pay for the top-ups.

Game goes from fun to predatory very quickly. They make the first 200 or so levels easy and fun. You'll have bonuses constantly, everything feels "correct". What I mean is that you can anticipate and feel the right way to beat levels. Then, you hit critical mass with their greed. Suddenly, there's no way to clear the level without burning a bunch of power ups. You'll spend coins to keep a level going, and no matter how much you avoid it, you'll need to spend money to have fun. Not me.

Not as advertised - don't bother with it. It's just another one of those match 3 type games.... I was expecting to play the game as advertised, that is a puzzle to save the King. I did get to save the King once, but it seems you need to reach certain levels before "The Kings Nightmare" option is available. Once you play the kings nightmare the game goes back to match 3.. I'm not going to bother with it and am going to delete its now. Such false advertising

The illusion of control. You win when they want you to win, and that becomes exceedingly scarce as you get further along in the game. There's really no incentive to stick with the game long term. Nearer players will rapidly finish more levels than you, and that is the key metric the entire game is based upon. This makes it impossible to finish quests like hatching the dragons, even if you okay for HOURS. They get 2 stars for not bombarding you with 3rd party ads, but that's where the good ends.

Much like Fishdom and their ilk, these games will manipulate you to pay money to advance. The so called "random" fall of gems in this game is designed to get you so very close to completing a level and then yank it away from you. In order to continue you just have to buy some game coins with real cash. Beware! The gameplay is fun and enjoyable with no ads popping up. It will play you to get money out of your pocket! At level 1012 and the algorithm took me 1 hour and 20 min to beat it. Scam!

Don't waste your time. the farther you go, the more impossible the levels get. They give 22 moves to clear 75 different items, some of which have to be hit 3x with bombs, which are not provided. Obviously designed to get you so frustrated that you purchase the helps, but I'm uninstalling instead. Challenging games are great, but making it literally impossible to pass is just greedy and annoying. Do not waste your time, it's infuriating, and I'm actually disgusted with this game/experience.

This is fun for a while. The graphics are cute and the game runs smoothly. There's enough going on with ways to earn things and progress through the story to be interesting. However, like most in-app purchase games, this one starts to require money after about 3 hours of play. The games quickly become too hard to win without buying add ons. And the add ons are expensive. You can get to $20 in a heartbeat and it goes up from there.

The entry levels are the same as other games, no big deal. Nothing like the ads for the game , saving the king. Games might become similar to the ad later, but not worth waiting to find out. True there aren't any ads, but the ads for this game are obnoxious, overly long (1 minute), and continually showing. Their ads sort of ruin the games I do like. Wish there was a way to block their ads and a few others from showing.

I like the game for the most part but they took away the daily small games to save the king. Now they show up only occasionally. And I have never seen the small games they show enticing people to install the game. I wish they would have more of those, as they can be fun, & adds something different to the game which can become "the same ole, same ole". I keep the game primarily to help out my fellow members, not because it is as much fun as it used to be.

The game is fun and addictive. However, it's completely set up to make you purchase coins. The game maker says, "Every level can be beat without spending money." But honestly, who wants to spend a week on the same level cause you don't want to spend money? It costs you 900 coins for five extra moves, if you still can't win, the next five moves cost you double the coins, and so on. Yet if you win a level, you win a measly 25 or maybe 40 coins. Stay away, this game sucks in the end!!!

If you were looking for yet another game with misleading ads and it turns out it's just another match 3 game, then boy do I have the game for you! It *is* visually appealing and cute, if a bit cartoon-y, and well animated. Each level gives you a star and you spend those stars on building different areas. However, you don't get to choose what any of it looks like, so in a way you're paying with stars to continue. The ads made this game look interesting, but this is not the game I'm looking for.

Update: Is there a way to give ZERO stars? Developers stop the false television ads.WOW, how very disappointing this game ended up being. When I first started playing, it was very exciting. Then, once I got around level 400, it turned into a CASH COW BUCKET. Even though I had read multiple reviews that felt the same way, I still stayed optimistic. I even stopped playing for a while to see if I had just misjudged the game. Unfortunately, I was correct in a four hour time frame I spent $ 50.

I have to say, I did kind of expect this when I first installed this game. I didn't play for that long, because I quickly figured out exactly what I had expected. False advertising. Ok, so maybe not completely. In the ads, it's shows you have to save the king by solving puzzles. It has you solve puzzles, but only every once in a while can you actually do the "save the king" part shown in the ads. The simple solving puzzles part might be fun for some people though. It's just false advertising.

I was thinking there can't be a worse match 3 game than Candy Crush, but here we are. Game starts quite well, easy and fun, good graphics and good mechanics, they actually put a lot of thought on how to be better than CC. But everything starts after level 500, levels are hard, there are not enough moves to complete a level unless you have a lot of bonuses, game forces you to spend money. Match 3 games should be fun, this game starts as a fun game and evolves to a complete p2w. Awful game.

The game in theory is actually really fun, especially when you first start it. I'm not a game person and I even got sucked in. However, as you move on throughout the game becomes much much harder to pass to the point where you'll have to play each level over 30-50 times just to eventually pass. I loved this game so much but uninstalled at level 270 because of this. Also, you can tell the game is a cash grab because you magically will pass the level once you purchase something.

Fun in the beginning. No ads is nice. I do not spend money to play any game so that has not been a problem. I am well passed 1300 and the game just takes up too much time trying to pass levels. There are never enough power ups, spending 900 coins for 5 moves is way too much and having to take three hits to open eyes, flowers and the the greenery is ridiculous. Plus what is with the cards. Every 20 cards you get a new one. I must have 100 duplicates with a number which means nothing. Deleting now

Starts off fun and relaxing. The algorithm quickly ramps up the cash grabbing. You will find your aelf needing just one more move to beat levels while being prompted to purchase the golden pass for the months season. You buy that and in 10-20 levels you are once again needing one, two and at times ten more moves. The save the king levels are only at 50, 150, 250 etc. It becomes relentless and infuriating. Six months of this pattern and I've deleted.

Be warned, while it's great in the very beginning, as you move on, everything becomes so difficult to get, such as earning extra tools, etc. and the amount of coins required to get extra turns is ridiculous, & if you don't pay, you lose power & then stand NO chance at all. The game is rigged so that you just ALMOST make it on many rounds, which entices you to pay. If you don't want to spend a lot of money, don't bother playing this game PERIOD.

While the overall gameplay is technically great, the experience is outweighed by the algorithm's need to try and get you to spend your money. If you want to play the same level 10, 20, 30, or more times before it decides to let you win then this game is for you. If there was a single pay version of this game it would be great. Instead you are at the the mercy of the algorithm, even if you spend your money on it. It's rigged to get you upset enough to buy coins, etc. Bad for your mental health!

The difficulty rating in this game is trash. You could play levels rated "super hard" in one try and end up playing the easy ones over 50 times. It's the most frustrating thing about the game. This game has too many levels (over 7000) and it doesn't make sense to play a level, that's supposed to be easy, 30-50 times before winning it. It's obvious y'all just want to make money and you designed it that way.

Yes, there's no ads, but that also means there's no way to get extra lives or changes without spending actual money. I'd much prefer to watch an ad or two in order to get extra turns over paying real cash. As others have said, you can get to levels that are basically impossible without extreme luck or paying money. Uninstalled after getting stuck on a level for 5 days with no hope in sight.

Game is quite fun, but come on seriously $9.99 for the royal pass when other games are $4.99??? Too high for just a game. I have spent money on other games but the prices on this one are ridiculously high and will not be spending money here. With all the negative reviews I have read about the costs of this game you would think they would lower, but no they are too greedy, and not realizing that if they do lower it, then a lot more would spend money here. Guess I'll continue my other games
Simple yet fun. While the main gameplay is matching, it does have games similar to the ones in the ads on occasion. Bright and colorful and easy to follow. Puzzles aren't frustratingly hard.

This game starts out fun but as you advance, the levels take several hours to several days to pass. This frustration is compounded when, at the end of another unsuccessful level, an in-app purchase is offered for 30 additional moves. Level 1089 is where I uninstalled the game, after 5 days stuck on the level, I realized the game was no longer any fun. There are lots of purchase icons everywhere on the main screen, always trying to sell you successful level completions. Graphics are great though.

I feel like I'm the victim of another bait and switch. Gameplay is not at all like the advertising that made me want to download the game. Not really surprised, just disappointed. Expected real puzzles and the challenge of timed completion to save the king. Got another match 3 game. It's cute but so far a little easy to me. Going to keep it for my kids.

This game is fun!! Don't feed into the reviews about having to spend money to advance in game, I'm on level 96 and haven't spent a penny!! This is a stragedy game so use your free items wisely and before each round it tells you the difficulty of each level. Join a group and have fun!! For those saying you have to pay to play maybe stragedy games are not for you, you earn coins and prizes in the game that help you advance... Awesome game!

Minus a lot of points because they advertise heavy the 'saving the king' levels which I saw none of. If they had them occasionally, or at least didn't make it the focus of the majority of their ads I wouldnt care so much. Otherwise it's no different from many other games in this genre. Like all of them you reach a point where it is nearly impossible to beat without buying extras, I get they need to make money but I'm not falling into that money pit.

There are so many times during this game when I should have gotten a rocket, bomb, helicopter when I move the pieces it just disappears or becomes something less! Ie. A ball becomes a rocket ! Also, whenever I am using my special items, they always seem to go places that are not necessarily needed for me to succeed on that level. I feel as if the only way to succeed at this game is if you spend money! Nothing more frustrating than playing a game and not getting the items you should.

It was way too expensive... if you're interested in the challenge, it is extremely fun. It's just way too much money to play consistently. Five lives, and if you are almost finished and out of moves, you start paying 900 gold for just 5 moves. It's a fun game, but not worth paying 9.99 or more to buy gold just to play more. No ads, but the negative content to buy gold is worse. I would pay 30 dollars or even more to purchase to own, but it's a money pit otherwise.

It's a well put together 3 match game, with a few original power qurks and solid art... But I have not seen a game not only end power up streaks when you fail a puzzle (and alot of the game us about keeping streaks active) but take progress from you when you fail for items you already won. In order to push you to buy more gold to get extra moves. Its one of the worse pay to win models... Cause it's not pay to win... But it's pay to not lose more. Player Beware.

Edit down to one star. Progress has become impossible in the last two months. Can no longer get past stage 1 in the challenges, and even after buying in game coin, can barely make it past levels. Used to get the occasional streak and play for an hour or so. More frustrating than it's worth and no longer a good value for in game purchases. Game idea gets a 5. Game play went from 5 to 1. Owner greed -10 points. Will no longer spend money if it gets me nowhere in the game.

Game is very fun, especially in the early goings. As you progress, it gets more and more difficult. I have started losing interest though because once you get to the higher levels (I'm over 1k) it's definitely designed to be pay to win. Every level I play now requires extra pieces, moves, etc. and as much as I like the game, I'm not spending money on it.

I downloaded this game to earn diamonds for another game. It's definitely a pay-to-win game. The levels are easy at first, but then they get so difficult that there's almost no way to beat them without apending money. I would get stuck on levels for days to a week. The game is nothing like the ads. It's yet another match threw game. Occasionally, you'll get a "King's Nightmare" that features one level that the ads show. I gave up on getting my rewards and uninstalled.

The game play is pretty good, I do enjoy games like this, however it feels like the game is either pushing you in the way of buying more moves. It also punishes you for having a bad rng (random number generator) which doesn't seem right. It makes these "super hard" levels and forces you to complete them or delete the game. All in all its a nice layout but I wouldn't recommend it.

Royal Match ads are misleading, as they completely exaggerate the game. This is simply a marketing strategy to capture your attention – and it works! The game has been downloaded over 180 million times by players all around the world. There is no king to be rescued at all! And be careful with in-app coin purchases! Just don't do it, they have an algorithm to make the gane harder for those tend to spend money so you buy more and need to use coins more! Just like many other games.

The ads for this game are horrible. They don't allow you to return to your game without restarting the game, AND you don't even get the reward for watching the stupid ad. I'm very surprised that Disney Magic Kingdom allows these types of ads. Because of this, you couldn't pay me to download this ripoff of a game. I wish that I could rate it less than one star. They shouldn't allow ads like this. We should boycott every game created by this ripoff company. This is entirely unfair. Crooks.

It's ok, but ultimately just another match game, and they're all pretty similar and pretty tedious after a few minutes. Also, way too much going on. What's the point of all the side missions etc? The incessant ads for it in other games make it appear far more interesting than it actually is (ironic that the game that boasts about not having ads advertises itself so aggressively).

over priced and unfairly rigged, gone from monthly 14.99 to weekly 7.99, as If a game this Rigged is worth spending almost $30 on. you only pass levels IF you spend on more props, you are stuck on levels for days until you spend money then you pass about 20 levels in one hit, its so rigged. I only stay because we have a great team and the Banter is engaging, supportive with lives and cards. without this team the game would be pointless. stop being so greedy. we are boycotting the weekly fee!!!!

Pay 2 play, and super cheaty. Sure, no ads are great and all, but when you have to spend days on just 1 level? No thank you. Every time there's always 1 more piece of grass, or one more bottle that you need to destroy and you've just used your last move. They want you to spend your money on their game. Also, it's kinda cheaty. I've set off bombs and watched 5 or more of the same color fall down right on top of one another. Did I get a light ball? Nope. Got the Canon.

The advertisements are far from what most of the game levels are. I understand that there are no advertisements so they have to make money somehow, but the number of times they try to get you to pay for boosts/rewards/etc is very off-putting to me. Especially when you "win" a series of prizes that must be accepted in order, and you cannot accept free prizes without first accepting paid prizes. I deleted the app after a few days, there are more fun match games out there.

Not quite as advertised. Once every 10 or 20 levels there is a "king's nightmare" option. Those are pretty much regular game play against the clock. I've been playing this for days and have not yet seen any level where game play clears a path for the king to escape as is shown in the ads. It's like the developers know the game isn't as good as it could be, know what would make the game better, and decide to just do that in the ads instead of the actual game.

DO NOT SPEND MONEY! Ive been playing for over a year without having spent any money! last month I bought my first $20 package and let me tell you.. The game changes! You get stuck on an easy level and have to play it 30+ times, and when you finally win 10 in a row to get your super light ball, you lose it right away because there are ZERO opportunities to match 5!! Then after you lose it and replay the same level, there are at least 10 light balls! Every single time!!! literally!

It was fun until Level 18. Then it started telling me "no more moves"(or "out of moves") or whatever; ok, so I need to try again, fine, sometimes that happens. After several re-tries, I started watching more closely; and the game would tell me "no more moves" when I could clearly see at least one or two more moves. Leaving one star only because I have to leave more than zero, and uninstalling the game.

Don't waste your time on this game!!!! It advertises No Ads - thats because they make it up with you buying extra lives and boosters. As you get further in the game, unless you want to spend about $5.00's for add ons a level you won't get past it. Developer will state you can pass each level with no boosters, that only happens about 1 in 40. With boosters it is about 1 in 25. You get 1 life every 30 minutes. It will take roughly a week to pass a single level.

The game is decent, and there are no ads. But unless you want to constantly feed the developer your wallet, the game is impossible to play. With the objectives to complete while playing, it is virtually impossible to complete unless you are constantly making in app purchases. To clear the levels (boards) you need to purchase additional items to clear obstacles and/or clear areas to get to other parts of level. Uninstalled game, too greedy of developer.

DO NOT DL! It definitely starts off fun but gets very addictive and not in a good way. It is rigged to ensure you have to purchase. If you don't, you can spend hours just repeating the same techniques to get to the next level with no end in sight. Graphics are psychologically designed to get you addicted to the game. As I played, I literally thought to myself, "this must be what gambling addiction feels like". I actually wanted to stop but couldn't. PSYCHOLOGICALLY HARMFUL! DO NOT DOWNLOAD!

Lost A lot of my Enthusiasm...This game was my top choice for several months. I've even spent money in order to replenish lives/beat levels. However, I've noticed glitches that pop up occasionally. Time on lives disappearing, games disappearing after only a few min., etc. A few days ago I complained to "support"and was basically told nothing could be done. Telling me next time inform them when it happens (what I did). Will no longer spend money on this game or play as much. Very Disappointing

Royal Match used to be lots of fun. playing without ads is definitely a perk. however, lately, they have taken away lots of additional stuff. when you buy the seasonal pass, no more extra moves! the levels have gotten more difficult. I had 2 accounts at different levels and now I am unable to progress with my lower account at the same rate from my original. even with in app purchases, they are making it way more difficult to move forward now.

Was fun at first but then it got too hard to complete levels without paying for more moves. Playing the same level again and again and again gets really old really fast. It's also really frustrating when you "run out of lives" and have to wait 25+ min to play again one time.. It's like they don't want me to play their game. I'm not going to pay for more lives or moves, why not let me watch an ad for one? 🤷

This game has turned into a money grabbing exercise. Used to be a brilliant fun game, no ads and you could get through the levels, maybe hard levels took a while but you got through. Now it takes forever and forces you to use all your hard earned rewards and moves that would normally clear the board, such as the power ball crossed with a propeller, fall short so you have to use additional items. The team games, although fun, are now so hard to get through. Shame on the money hungry developers.

Sometimes it's properly challenging, and a nice way to pass the time. However, it's based almost entirely off of luck, and you can be stuck on a level with far too few moves to do anything, and it'll take actual days or weeks just to progress. Artificial difficulty is a good word; it's not challenging, it's clearly just meant to make you give up and pay them to move on. Joke's on you, I'm genuinely too poor to pay for games.

This game is fun at the start, but after reaching higher levels, they become increasingly difficult to pass. It will take many days to pass a single level, so you are unable to compete in any of the completions with others and are not able to complete challenges to get the needed rewards to help pass levels. If you fail at level, items are taken away, thus making it even more difficult to pass. You are also limited on attempts to pass, so game play becomes very frustrating. Not recomended.

The game is fun when lightning ball is active. But, it'll cost real money to keep it active. When it's not active, be prepared to do each round 10-30 times. They'll put hard and super hard designations on rounds, but in reality, the regular rounds are just as hard, and you play them as many times as a hard round to complete them. This is meant to frustrate you to pay to play. The developers are greedy and add new frustrations to get you to pay. After years of playing, I'm done with the greed.

Game was fun at first. Then it asked me to rate it. I clicked maybe later. Then came level 18. This level is designed to remove all your assistant tools. In order to finish, I had to use 3 cannons, 3 arrows, 4 hammers, and still had to buy 10 more moves which took almost all my coins, 2700. Ya, if you want to be treated this way in a game early on, this game is for you. Like most people through out the eras I say, let this little king die. Deleting this game now!

just another Candy crush clone with some decorating elements that everyone has seen about 1000 ads for. Honestly, there's too many of these games being released nowadays. And you know how they go. First few levels are easy enough, then they crank up the difficulty and start dangling the microtransactions in front of you. If you want to play this game then go ahead. But just remember that the thrills won't last very long.

Zero stars if I could. Levels that are hard are unfair when they want them to be. You can get stuck on a level until they pretty much "help" you win. Very uneven play. I used the app for a long time before finally giving in at around 3500..the only reason I lasted that long was due to the no ads policy. Don't waste your time investing. Find another way to spend time not glued to your phone.

Fun is game for a while until you have completed all the areas. Then, it's impossible to continue without buying extremely expensive boosters or coins. The game seems to be rigged, as even when you have cleared the field of any objects, if you don't buy anything, one or two objects will remain on the field and force you to buy more moves if you want to advance. Waste of time, scam, and no different than Candy Crush. Don't bother with this game.

An ok game but gets repetitive and boring after a while. My main gripe is that the game doesn't match the advertising, which only shows levels where you have to clear a path of some sort to save the king. In the game, that's only in rare "King's Nightmare" levels. Same deal with Royal Kingdom. I don't understand why they don't furnish the game they advertise, or have advertising that represents the actual game. All they accomplish by deliberate misrepresentation is to frustrate and annoy people.

game doesn't match the ads. It's so annoying. The expectation is that you will be playing an interactive game of sorts to save the kings from a scenario, but most of the time, you will just be playing a candy crush type game to make additions to the castle. Like, really, how hard is it to make the game match the ad. if it was possible, i would rate it 0 stars. Game developers can burn in hell with all due respect

I used to really like this game. it was a really fun thing to do when I had a quick second to play, Thank you get to about to level 2-3 thousand, and they make the levels pretty much impossible to play without having to buy extra Buffs bonuses and such. play intentionally good to you into the game long enough that you want to keep playing but you need money to keep playing. I deleted it! I hate these type of predatory type gaming!!!

No, 95% of this game are not whats shown in the adverts that are so ubiquitous currently. Worse though, the game is clearly setup to make you spend money and is not skill based at all. You will progress well though the early levels, but once you hit 150 or so, things will start to crawl and you will find you are constantly losing with the occasional 'miraculous' win coming if you struggle long enough so the game can keep your interest. If you are prone to spending on online games beware!

I do not understand how this game ends up with an average of 4.6. Please read the other reviews. I agree with the negative reviews. I finally gave in to the ads from the who the hell knows who they are actors and downloaded the game. Initially, it was fun but not representative of the ads. The levels become more difficult and frustrating unless you might be a super gamer. PLAY THIS GAME TO HELP MAKE GOOGLE RICHER. TOO MUCH MONEY!

A really fun and beautiful game that becomes impossible to solve in higher levels without spending large amount of money. Deleting at level 117 as, after over 50 attempts, the level is not solvable without paying for it. If there were occasional ads, I would have been happy to watch them if it meant I could progress in the game. Without ads or large amounts of cash, the game is impossible to beat. Better and less frustrating games out there, IMO.

Was 4-star and now a 1-star. I don't buy in-game boosts, power-ups, etc. This is a cash grab game with no ads. I hit a wall after using all the boost the game gave me. I spent 50 lives on one level. 50! The puzzle at level 250+ can not be beat without buying extra boost/power-ups, extra moves, etc. Even as an ad free, false trailer game, it's not worth it anymore.

Do not play this game. The company only exists to extort money from players. They constantly change the rules to make the game harder to play, trying to force players into buying things like extra lives and "coins" that are normally rewarded throughout the course of the game. They then drop those coin values over time, making it more and more difficult to progress through levels. Do not start to play, the game will frustrate and upset you down the road after you get addicted.

Enjoy the game for the most part, but having to use 900 coins to continue playing if you don't finish on the first try is ridiculous, 1900 for the next level. So even when you do spend money to get additional coins, they're gone very quickly. Very scam-ish, if you ask me. I understand every company has one goal, and that's to many money, but if I'm willing to spend the money, I appreciate getting a more bang for my buck, so I'm not spending anymore on this game, and don't play much anymore.

Nice and fun up to level ~200 when it becomes a money grabbing machine. You burn through your powerups and lives and even then you cannot beat some levels without retrying multiple times. I reached 222, retried that level for 4-5 sessions burning through lives with no luck, so uninstall and so long. I can gladly pay for some games when I feel that the game is fair, not the case here, definitely. Oh, and spare me with the canned reply "our developers are constantly working to grab your wallet!"

The game starts out really well. Challenging levels mixed with some easier ones. A few thousand levels in, and it gets to the point where you can not proceed without purchasing stuff. At that point, it becomes tiresome, and one looks for alternative games in the same genre. Some advice for the developers... let those who want to pay do so. Just don't force others who actually like and refer your game to go elsewhere because it gets boring after 30 or 40 attempts to pass a level.

the game is not fun anymore. I'm at the end continually I'm the top players in the arena. complete the new levels as released, all good! the problem is I'm not buying anything anymore. after purchasing the levels get easier for about 100 levels. everything is doable, favorable drops and lightballs everywhere. after those levels pass it's nearly impossible. I'm done purchasing, now I cannot compete, each level takes 20 to 30 tries.

Yet another game that isn't like the commercials. I don't understand why they do that. Do they think they will trick people into spending money on a game that isn't what they were hoping to play? It's not a BAD game, it just isn't the gameplay I wanted. I thought maybe the "King's Nightmare" levels would be it, but no - they are just the same as the regular levels but with a time crunch. A far better iteration of this exact gameplay imo is Jewel Dragon. It's obviously made by the same people.

I played this game for 2 years and it's just a cash grab. Theres an algorithm that decides when you've had too much success or stored too many resources and then it will destroy you until you either pay or struggle for some amount of time. The game is not really based on skill and is more like a slot machine than anything. You're always at the mercy of the algorithm . I finished 10,000 levels and was never able to get ahead. Even spending money isn't a guarantee that it won't destroy you anyway.

After you clear the initial levels the game becomes increasingly difficult, which is fine. However, even with strategy higer levels essentially require bonus items. Sure, maybe you can beat a hard level after a number of days, but it's a cash grab to buy those items. Personally I would stay away unless you're looking to spend money to be a top player. To be clear, the first 150 or so boards weren't bad, but once you cross 200 it gets ridiculous.

Deceptive advertising! The ads don't represent normal gameplay. You have to play through a LOT of boring match-3 levels to get to the occadional more creative puzzles. The building/decorating of the castle and grounds is annoying, and I never did figure out what the cards are for. I downloaded this game and its "sibling," Royal Kingdom, thinking that they'd offer different puzzles, but they're pretty much the same.

The game is fun, standard puzzle game. However, although there are no ads, the app has to make money so they set the gaming experience up where you have to purchase boosters or coins in order to advance to the next level. Yes, you can beat the levels w/o boosters or coins but it will take a lot of time. So the game is free to play with no ads but the catch is at some point you will purchase boosters and coins, and that is how the app get you. Stop having people with money advertise the game.

Similar to Candy Crush type games, this game is no different. The developers have clearly designed this game to encourage in-game purchases. After a generally fun experience, the game gets so hard that it almost makes it necessary to purchase in-game currency to progress pass levels. I simply refuse to purchase anything. However, it is very clear that in-game purchases is the goal of the developers.

I had this game for quite awhile, and made the mistake of investing money in it , it's so much bs when you don't . I finally got fed up and deleted it , I got up to level 450 and without money it took over a week to get over one more level , and when you did spend money on it , the stuff you bought only lasted a couple of hours !!! So no more .....

I installed the game especially for King's Nightmare levels. However; those levels are not as introduced in the ads. In the ads, the King moves forward as you match boxes and you can reveal heroes to help fight monsters chasing you, you can solve pipeline puzzles, etc. The actual game levels are about only matching tiles within a given time frame. There is no King's movement, no surprises, no chasing monsters, no heroes revealed, no different puzzles. It is another game different than its ads.

It was fun until it wasn't. I'm at level 1914. After about 150-200 levels, it gets hard. Then it gets ridiculous! Buy coins it seems even harder, so you'll spend those and buy more coins. Purple boxes are blocked but you have to hit them 3 times too throw out green, only throws out 3 green, then you have to hit each green 2 times and you need 30 of those to pass? Several goals are like that. Get real! A week to pass 1 level. These games are supposed to be relaxing, but they cause anxiety.

IMO, the ads for this game are stupid! Some of them drag on for a whole minute while you can clearly see how to help the king escape, but the ads only show failure after failure. The whole premise of the game is lame. What King would ever build a castle with a series of traps and dangerous creatures and no guards or other people to help him? No real king, that is for sure. And I find it highly annoying when the ad is "stuck" and won't close, so the only way to escape is to completely exit.

Was a great game. Was the best match three game there is. Level 217? What's with level 217? Can't get past it unless you pay. I'm assuming it only goes downhill from there. Edit: Don't waste your time! In the months since my last review I've managed to get to level 223. Not fun and a severe waste off time. Weird, greed I guess. More irritation than game!

Extremely frustrating. The game was actually super fun and chill at first but after playing for a while the levels get a bit challenging, as they should, but the problem was that there then comes a point where they become unwinnable unless you pay for cheats or extra moves. I was literally stuck on the same level for more tries than I can count for like over a week, which unfortunately means I'm just gonna delete the app. Sad because it was fun until then.

A good game, but designed in the way where you either wait 140+ minutes to have 5 attempts on progressing a difficult level, or you pay the money, and increase your chances, no guarantee that you will succeed. A lot of games do that nowadays, but I'm just tired seeing an AD of this game. I thought at first all you do is rescue the king, and with the amount of ads I saw, I honestly wanted to fail on purpose. This game was advertised as "This game has no ads!". In other words, lots of P2W stuff.

The save the king you see in the ads is rarely shown in the game. I was under the impression that the entire game would be played that way but it isn't. I still played it anyway because it has no ads and you can play offline. However, after the updates, the rewards are now lower in all events and challenges so you're basically doing the same amount of work for less rewards. This game used to be fun to play but I'm quickly loosing interest in playing since they just want you to spend real $$

I have noticed that the nightmares of the King, happen every 50 rounds or so. The hard levels are very hard, you have to stop playing for at least 3 days for you to get what you need to complete such levels. Also, the Train Journey is ridiculous. After you spin the wheel no matter the amount 20 to 200, the little rail tokens take thousands to move from one check point to another. It's a fun game, but just know- these things exist.

The game is fun to play but the further you go and the harder the levels get there is really no choice but to buy more coins to continue playing. Yeah there are ways to earn boosters but they don't help much. When you run out of moves and do have coins to proceed its *900*!!! coins for 5 extra moves. That's crazy, especially when there's other games where it's 500 for 10 extra moves. This game will suck you in, but then you'll spend a lot of money to play or just get frustrated and quit anyway

I downloaded this to earn points on a gift card app since I'm usually good at match 3 games but...there's too much going on. When I play a match 3 game, I just want the game levels, not a ton of different pop ups for whatever events the dev team came up with. 1 or 2 is fine, but sometimes I get what feels like 10. It's too much, and it interrupts the game flow. I'm only continuing to play to get my points at this rate.

This game sucks. It lets you get into the game then they want me to pay to play. Every time I have to watch one of their "minute long ads," I'm going to add to the list the resons why this game is a fraud. First off, the "minute long ads," which are deceiving, only show the fun part of the game ( when you are saving the king) which you only get to play once in a blue moon. Otherwise the game is a bejeweled ripoff.

I am all for games that are difficult, but it gets impossible without power-ups. This game is the type that forces people to buy coins just so you can progress. Games like this are supposed to be fun to waste time not lose 30 times before you can win, then run out of coins to not be able to progress after you win 1 round. Then it feels like each time you win, you barely get any coins. I beat a level on level 240 and had 15 moves to go. After that I only got 60 coins. 60 coins?!!!

You're better off playing the casino games. At least you are gambling. After 250 levels I understand why you guys spend so much on marketing. Ease up....it's not that serious. Also the levels start to repeat themselves but with different conditions. 60 blocks with items...you start with 3 avaliable to play with 15 moves. I like a challenge too but what are you trying to prove? I'm not going to spend money lol. If by some chance I decide to spend 5 dollars...it's not by your influence. P2p game

this game is a dirty lie. the fun levels you see in the ads, where you have to save the king, those are "special" levels. you only get 1 every 10 to 15 levels. this is just candy crush where you also have to decorate various rooms of your castle. also, after about level 125, you HAVE to use items to beat levels and you will eventually have to pay for them.

This game has some levels that are so hard you have to purchase stuff to be able to pass the level. It is no fun to play the same level over and over for days not hours but for days. It gets very frustrating. I finally just uninstalled it after 7 days stuck on the same level. Level 2965 is impossible to pass unless you purchase something. They dont give you near enough moves been stuck on it for 9 days. Not fun just makes a person incredibly angry. Why do you make them so hard. Its not fun

The game is extraordinarily well crafted and addictive to play. Unfortunately, like so many other games these days, you eventually come to a point where you MUST spend money in order to progress. The levels (must necessarily) become more challenging, and your free resources only last so long. Restarted with a new phone. The game *does* lie about some player challenges. Regardless how fast you finish one, it always immediately determines your cut, like you're always the last one done.

Got tired of paying to pass. I could eventually pass a lot of the puzzles for free, I had to get lucky with the more powerful pieces. After 3-4 days I can't even get close to finishing, and "5 more moves for more money" won't help, I gave it up. Probably spent $50 total in about 14 days, I'm saving my money. Uninstalled. I enjoyed it otherwise.

The game is fun but once you hit the higher levels it's designed to force players to spend money in order to pass the levels. Not much fun after that. When you can complete 164 levels on the first try, then the rest take dozens of attempts and still unable to pass, it's obvious they are designed for those who will spend money on the extras. So, oh well, more free space on my galaxy, Uninstalled and erased.

This is a fairly fun game, but it is designed to extract money from you. You can only get so far without paying money for more "gold". You are penalized and lose earned "books" or other earned items if you don't pony up the gold to continue play (talk about coercion). At some point there will be a puzzle sufficiently difficult that it will be impossible to complete without having gold to extend play. Add that to the constant nag ads and this is no different than the many entries of the genre.

THE BIGGEST MONEY GRAB! Used to be 5 stars, have played for years. then watched as the greed slowly took over. The rewards reduced and the need for "1 more turn" drastically increased. What used to be fun and I spent money on occasion because I wanted to - turned in to pay to play if you want to keep your win streak. I refuse to pay into that model. So you'll get no more money from me.

UPDATED: I FINALLY got the game going without it waiting forever and I have some disappointing results: whoever said that this very game was just like all of the other match-three puzzle games, you are 100% right. It is nothing like the advertisements AT ALL and I was SUPER disappointed. It wouldn't be so low if I didn't already own or well know of a much better and very similar match-three puzzle like Harry Potter: Puzzles and Spells, which is much more engaging and almost addicting!

It was a great game to begin with, but after you get into the higher levels it's just a payday for the developers. It gets to where you have to buy more moves to complete a level. You have no chance if you don't. Also they will start a level with so few pieces, power ups are no good. Was fun while it lasted, but the makers of this game can cramp it in thier @$$. I will spend no more money.

My experience is similar to the others. I am not interested in paying to play, which is pretty much a requirement once you get to the higher levels. Happy to pay a proper fee ONCE to install a game and maybe see an ad after each level, but not whatever they are doing in this game. Not fun having to replay the same level dozens of times.. Uninstalling.

Greedy creators. It was fun and addictive so I purchased quite a bit of perks in game. No matter what moves you make, the next pieces to come into play won't work for what you need to complete the level, so you have to buy perks or lose your streak. Everything will be good for a few levels when you get your streak back up, then it'll happen again, trying to make you buy more. Once you buy anything, they dig for more and more. If you don't give in, they make it hard to advance.

Been playing it for a couple of years. Level 11000+. Used to be fun and exciting. That has gone out of the window. Algorithms are absolutely rigged. Doesn't need a scientist to figure out that game is trying to force you to spend money. Sometimes even the simplest of levels won't finish until you retry 2 or sometimes 3 times. Earning coins has always been incredibly hard. 900 for the first retry was too much. Now rewards have diminished and it's all about $$$ sadly.

Pros: They were right, there's no ads. Cons: If you're here for the ad games, that's only very rarely [every 20-40 levels? Can't recall]. And once you hit a wall- and that's going to happen FAST, because this game doesn't even start easy [comparing it to, say, Candy Crush, Candy Crush has a very smooth difficulty curve to several hundred levels, and Royal Match STARTS about halfway through that]- you just. Won't be able to advance anymore. 20 lives and nothing. So yknow. Beware.

For an app that doesn't have adds, can be played with or without a Internet connection, and still make enough money to advertise on other game apps or other companies apps is bewildering for me. After 30 puzzles or more, I FINALLY get a puzzle to save that king's life. Their ads make it look like there are many puzzles. Nope. My concern Royal Kingdom is just this. My device slowed down, the battery burned faster, & MAY have conflict with other apps. It's fun, but it's not a challenge for me.

Boring. You'd think by the way they hyped this game that it would be anything but a boring, dime a dozen match 3 game. Big whoop, it's ad free. It doesn't make the game more interesting to play, and it certainly doesn't make the game they show in their ads a realization. If you think you want to play based on an ad you saw, don't bother, the game in no way resembles the ads. This is a game you can't win if you don't pay, ad free is just BS frosting.

it's fun at first. then it starts giving you moves that can only waste the minimal moves you have to win the puzzle, until you have 2 moves left and at 3 you can win. then to keep going you have to pay to continue or stay on that level for days. also, don't use play points to continue. they still want you to pay money. I've bought 3 coupons and you can't stack them. never got to use even one. I contacted the dev and never got a reply. if I didn't have to they'd get no stars. now I go to Google.

This game has genuine moments of fun, but they are quickly over shadowed by the fact that many many levels are impossible to beat without premium items. There is no strategy that can overcome this and the game is designed to force you to buy upgrades to succeed. It's unfortunate that yet another game comes down to if you're willing to pay or not. The competition for this game, and there are many, at least give you a workable way to overcome the puzzle. Very unfortunate.

Other negative reviews written here are pretty accurate. Couldn't get past 1500. Pretty stressful to play after you cross 1000. It takes 30+ tries at times to cross a difficult level if you're not willing to purchase anything. The outcome seems to be predetermined. You'll know at the start of the game whether you should play the full round or just quit and start all over.

Good for a few days, then not. The first 200 or so levels were very fun, then progressively difficult to the point of frustration. You'll have to pay for boosts every couple of levels to progress, or else just keep losing the same level over and over, waiting for timed free lives. I've paid one-time fees to remove ads on apps I like, but I'm not robbing my piggy bank every day to play a casual game. Sadly, uninstalling this one.

This game is fun at first but, having played it for a few months I've noticed a pattern. The game marks some levels as Super Hard but many of the levels that are not marked are actually much harder. It prevents you from completing them, offering extra turns if you spend coins. Eventually, when the algorithm gives up trying to get you to spend money, it lets you win the level. Rinse and repeat for each level. This seems to have gotten worse over the last week. I think it's rigged.

What is (somewhat) cleverly disguised as a "no ad" game, is very costly to play. And all the ads that you see advertising this game (in between your own game you're playing, ad nauseum) show all the fun mini games that you're supposed to be playing, but you play them only once every 50 levels. All in all, it's just a match 3 game and you have to spend a ton of money getting to the levels that you can't beat without spending the money. So, basically, don't let the "no ads" hype fool you.

As someone who's played this game for quite awhile (score is very high up), I've become very irritated with all the recent game changes. Lower coin returns, harder levels, increased amounts needed for earning rewards, rewards reduced, etc. I could give more examples, but space is limited. It is very obvious they are trying to force players into spending money. Sadly, the game has become very greedy and for the first time, I'm seriously thinking of quitting and so are my higher up teammates.

It started out fun and relaxing. But some of these levels are impossible. I'm not spending money to play a game when there are so many other choices. One level gives you 33 moves. You'll lose 15 just to get all the colors you need to open the 3 boxes. Then the rest to bust open cement blocks that need to be hit 3 times each to explode. so ridiculous. Play until it's not fun anymore...then go find something else.

Same frustrations as others. Once you get to higher levels it can take many, many attempts to pass the level. Have had levels numerous times where only one more item to clear and no more moves. Also the game doesn't provide the blaster even when the correct number of the same objects are connected. Great game to waste a lot of your time. I will not pay to play any game, so I guess I will be stuck on the same level for days upon days. More super hard levels than Kings nightmare or bonus levels.

If you're the type who'll spend money in a game, stay away from this one. They know how to manipulate you into spending more. I caught them changing "buying coin" options while in game. You've had a long session and you're about to tap out for the day and you get a round that threatens to clean you out. Guess what? No more $1.99 options to help eek you through. Oh, it was there earlier, but for some reason it's now not available. I uninstalled after the third time, definitely a pattern!

Greed Has Taken Over- The game USED to be awesome. You rarely "Save The King", I was tricked thinking that's what the game was all about. But, I ended up liking the game anyways. After spending money and time on this game, I think I'm done. The rewards have been reduced and the levels are hard to achieve. You could need only one gold card to win a challenge but you'll never get it. It's all luck and no skill. The games within the game is rigged. They want you to spend money.

I like Royal Match, it's a fun and challenging game, no ads. The only thing is when you see a preview of the game is not the same game that you're going to be playing they need to correct that. The part that you see in the ad for the game is what's called The King's nightmare, within the levels, and you have to win about 10 to 20 levels before you get to the king's nightmare. I give them four stars overall because that is still false advertising.

I had a similar experience as a lot of other users have. In the beginning was fun and hardly any ads. Then you get to the upper tier. There are levels where you have like 20 moves to get 40 of one thing and 34 of another and 22 of something else. Just know that in order to get to be able to try and get the 40, it takes 3 matches to get rid of the 34. This game was the one I went to in my spare time. Now, it is deleted and I came here to warn those who read reviews before downloading. Stay away!

It's laughable they classify some levels as hard or super hard. at some point even the easy levels are damn near impossible to beat. It's painfully obvious there is little to no play testing. What I would classify as an easier level can take days if not weeks to beat, UNLESS, you're will to spend a bunch of money buying add-ons. So basically, this game is just another money grub. Oh, and the only difference between, easy, hard, and super hard levels, is how many points you can earn.

There is so much potential with this game. But it falls short in many ways. They have plenty of ways that they almost make you pay, if you want to clear the higher levels. But there are very little options as far as what you can buy. I'd love options to be able to gift teammates with boosters or more lives or even coins. Gift packs we could gift would be amazing. Make the game more fun. We are on a team but cant even help each other. Fix it guys!! please! I'm on the team Pills. Active players

I downloaded this to see if the ads popping up would stop. The only part that really feels like those ads are the King's Nightmare levels, which are completely skippable by the way. It's fine, but it is not what the apps sell it as. The gameplay was gimmicky, with special power ups and challenges to sign up for, but I get skeptical that a matching game almost forces you to sign up for teams. It's a time killer, which I didn't need more of.

I planed to give 5 star review but after reading several other reviews about in app purchases being nessacary to advance in the game. After it dawned on me the amount of money I've spend playing this game. I enjoy the game and like that there's no ads. But I really don't like the idea of after getting to a certain point u have to pay to advance levels. I don't plan buy anything else from this point on. I will change my review once I see my progress without spending money.

I made it to level 108 and the game kept prompting me to connect my Facebook account so I finally gave in and did. Unfortunately, it reset my progress, doesn't give me any option to sign out of my Facebook account, and support is non-existent so I received no help in fixing this problem. Since I don't see a way to fix this huge issue, I will be deleting the app. Game itself was alright but definitely not fun enough for me to redo all of my lost progress.

Only gave this 2 stars instead of 1 because graphics are great, the match part is fun, addictive and gives you satisfying visuals when you get the power ups. But it's nothing like the ad. I installed it because I thought there I would be making matches to save the king in many different interesting and entertaining scenarios. But no. I'm so sick of games that are not advertised as WHAT THEY ACTUALLY ARE! If you take time to make a great ad, can you please make the game that goes with it??!!

The game is fun and very satisfying but higly addictive. I had to remove it for my own good because I started to spend more money than I was planning to. It gets you relaxed and kicks with enough endorfine so you feel good and confident and then you get to that super hard level that you cannot really do anything without extra powers and then little by little it gets to you so you start paying little amounts not to lose everything. I went from level one to level 1600 in one month. Don't do that.

This WAS a fun game; but ... they've put to many levels within a level. I made it to 94.. I AM READY TO DELETE THE GAME. (Where as before... I would have purchased the game!!) You dont just clear the grass... there are TWO colors of grass. Then mailboxes you cannot get to with UNREALISTIC Numbers To clear within one level ... without purchases... it is hard to move on and takes the enjoyment out of the game.

I was really enjoying this game as it was fun and relaxing. I'm up to level 188 and the levels are so blasted frustrating anymore and not fun. :-( I feel like I have to use so many power ups anymore to get past any boards. Some boards take 10+ tries before I can complete it and once then can I by using a bunch of power ups. I'm running out of the ones I've earned and don't have the money to be spending that their asking for more. I really loved this game too dang it. :-(

Too many ads, inappropriate content for children, scenes of despair and death, it's not fun! I can't press no enough! No, no, no, no, no, no,No! I realize you need to run ads I look at them and I have to close them three times in three different screens! I keep seeing other reviews saying the same thing and you apologize to them. I patiently watch the ads and I try the games, but once I say no, stop showing the ad! The gameplay isn't as advertised... Let me repeat: NO! Hell NO!!!!!

Fun game. Unfortunately I will be removing from my device because the cost is way too expensive. Coins are hard to earn. Boosters and lives cost much more than other games I have and this game is too hard and takes too many coins and boosters. As a senior I cannot continue to spend so much on a game. If you don't spend you get stuck on levels forever. I am sad because this is my favorite game.

I got stuck on an IMPOSSIBLE level. It's not "Super Hard," ITS IMPOSSIBLE. Been on level 195 for two days straight. I downloaded this game for a Fetch Rewards kind of deal, but now I'm stuck. I give up because I've used ALL of my power ups and I don't have COINS because I used them to add extra moves to other levels. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS GAME!!!

I like the game and have even purchased the golden whatever a couple times. Some levels are very difficult and make progress slow, but it's still a fun game. HOWEVER - it's WAY too easy to accidentally waste coins by tapping "play on". I hate games that feel like they're tricking you into spending coins. It doesn't need to offer "play on" multiple times. Ask me once and then let me try again. I've also experienced the glitch that others mentioned, swipe one direction and the piece moves a different direction. This is a very annoying bug, especially on the more difficult levels. For example, when I get one of the disco ball looking things and a bomb next to each other and I try to swipe to merge them - the bomb will swipe in the opposite direction and explode on its own instead of merging with the disco ball. Instead of getting multiple bombs, I now had a single bomb and the disco ball pops a random color. This issue has been happening more frequently since the last update. (Reply from developer does not address this odd bug with pieces swiping in the wrong direction. My complaints about the game are not about how difficult the levels are. If it was too easy it would get boring, I understand that. Nor does it address the annoying issue of asking us if we want to "play on" multiple times before giving the "try again" option. I'd be more likely to buy the golden whatever or other in-game items if it wasn't so easy to get "tricked" into wasting coins when I don't want to play on.)

You will never get enough coins or wins to keep playing for free. You ALWAYS have to buy to keep playing. The game also cheats. For example - you select four to get an arrow, and many, many times, it doesn't give it to you. Always, always leaves one or two moves, then requires using 900 coins as an option to complete. The most coins you can win are 10 - 200. Don't recommend it is NOT FREE!

SERIOUSLY ANNOYING!!! Terrible rating is for their incessant, irritating ads on other gaming apps. If I never saw another Royal Match ad it would be too soon. They are loooooong, like over a minute, and end with a static screen where you wait and wait. Then finally you see the X, you click it, and it downloads the app. I've hate these ads with a passion. In fact, no ads have been so successful in making me hate their product as much as Royal Match.

This and garden/house scape games are false advertisements. This is only a three match game with easy, medium, hard, and super hard levels that takes days to get to the next level. And the king's nightmare that sucks you in in the first place don't even exist except for, oh I don't know, 10 to 20 games, and they are the same "nightmares", it's nothing new. If I want to play these types of games I just stick with Candy Crush.

Pay to play and the cost is pretty high dollar. You can play the same level for days and not get more than 3 in a row which doesn't give you any explosives to clear the blocks so you'll need to fork over cash to do anything. Very frustrating and a total money grab for Dream. Dream. Yeah, they should rename the company Nightmare. It would be more accurate.

I regret ever downloading the game after seeing the ad about it where you would be required to save the king from some sort of danger, but in the game there is nothing of such. It's just a random game like candy crush where you will match colour tiles together. The developers only deceived people to download the game and as you progress in the game, you will be stuck at some point and would have to use real money before you can move ahead. I'm uninstalling right away

There's a lot I really like about this game - it's challenging and fun. However, I find the game is quite stingy when it comes to awarding coins when a game is won. It's frustrating when it costs 900 coins to repeat a game, but the award might be only 30-50 coins. It's also particularly frustrating when an Area is completed, we get the big BONUS round, but the boards are designed so that even when clearing board after board, the BIG WIN can be well under 900 coins.

I love match 3 games and because I am stuck at home, I downloaded this game today. I am on level 180 or so. Here is what I have experienced: 1. In the beginning, it is a lot of fun. The boards are not overly difficult, however, in the higher levels, there are insufficient number of turns to win levels. Most obstacles require power ups to break, no power ups, no win. This game wants you money and they will say "oh we'll work on on it" they will not because they want your money. 😵‍💫😡

Was my go-to game for a long time. Until I had a problem of losing saved up prizes of the night before. (I have done this every week for having extra stuff for the weekends) I contacted the support and was basically told "you must have claimed it" Done, no discussion, no nothing. I was Ignoring for 30 min afterwards. I'll admit that it is a fun and challenging game but .... For the love of what you deem Holly, don not spend a dime/cent on this game as you will be ignored if you have a problem.

They want you to pay for more moves, when in fact some of the Super Hard ones are easier than the regular puzzles. I let my some play all the time but when I realized he was wasting his money on a scam of a game I took it away from him. It's like a slot machine. I'm a retired mathamatician,and I calculated the moves it's BS.
