I love playing this game. It is a time killer but recently the prices have stayed the same buying things, But now you have taken away the amount of things We get , not so much worth Bang for buck anymore. Too expensive for what you get to play with , someone is trying to majorly cash in on us here, not good business, There is a saying that less is more. Try charging less and you will probably make more in the long run. Because you will get more people, it's just common sense.

Have you played a match 3 before? Yes? Then you have played this game before. All the same concepts just recycled in a new skin. If you like match 3 games already and absolutely crave to play the same thing over and over... then have fun... but if you're looking for something new... this ain't it. Edit: Many of the ads they are running are incredibly deceptive. The ads show a completely different game from the one it actually is. They include the game in the ads as a "minigame".

Great game! A few changes I think the game can be fantastic. I never do the lava challenge I feel each time I fail the level. The earned cards are too confusing. Also, the cost of coins to get 5 extra moves! Really 900 and then 1900. There should be a lower fee for extra moves! With 1x move....5x and 10x, we can choose the # At the end of a challenge,when there is no more moves left set off all extras that had been made to see if level wins. Thanks Apple

It's a Cartoon Blast clone with the same type of graphics, music style and match 3 gameplay. If you came here for what you see in the ads, you'll be disappointed. Those levels are few and far between. If that's what the entire game was, I would give it a higher review. Unfortunately, the game quickly becomes repetitive and virtually impossible after about level 200, where you are less likely to proceed without spending money. Otherwise, there are far better match 3 games out there. Move along.

Game was pretty fun, but my club was not active enough, and I hit a wall. I uninstalled via play store and app settings on my device, but it's still there. I wanted to start over, but I'm stuck with it now. Thanks for worming into my device so I can never get rid of it. Big thumbs down, and off with King Robert's head. I refuse to spend a penny on games, BTW

This game is designed to milk you for any dollar you would be willing to spend. It will present you with puzzles that are exceptionally challenging to pass without providing enough moves to complete them. You must remove 60 items from the board. Some take 2 moves to complete. The game will start you with 15 moves. It is very apparent the point is to force you to bear your head into the wall that is this game until you get frustrated and spend money. Garbage POS. I hope the designer suffers.

I wish that I could give less than zero stars to this damnable game! I do not want it, I never asked for it and yet it continues to Bombard me with add after add. 2, 3, even 4 times in a row and at the same time cutting the connection between my Roku and TV cutting the sound, in order to get the connection back I have to cut everything off and then back on over and over and over again just to be able to continue the video I am watching, PLEASE STOP! I. DON'T. WANT. THIS. DAMN. GAME!

The game started off easy and fun, then it started to get harder from around level 235, which is ridiculous. They give you less moves, packed with obstacles and even while moving, there's no chance to get power-ups out of it so you are forced to get more moves for too much money, for example, I had 10000 coins and power-ups that they give you at the bottom of the level but I used them all in about 20 levels then I started to get stuck in the levels so they FORCE YOU to pay!!! Uninstalled. Liars!

I've gotten all the way to level 589, but I can't seem to move up. The levels are all super hard now and as I found with several previous, only spending more money will allow you to progress. It's a total money pit, and I am trapped unless I spend, however, I refuse. I see folks with level 3000+ and I marvel - they must have spent hundreds of thousands to get where they are... Too bad the game doesn't provide powerups to assist. I'm loathe to spend any more. Your game has become a bore.

Big suprise, the ads are lying to you. I tested this terrible game, and I hated it. While it does work without wifi, even after playing 25 levels, there are NONE of the minigames you see in the ads. None of the levels are about saving the king from rocks or spikes, it is just a basic match-3 game with large font and flashy lights to make old ladies like it. Essentially, I wasted an hour of my life so you dont have to.

This game is dangerously addictive and NOT FREE. If you want to advance beyond introductory levels, you'll pay at least $3 and up to $20 every couple of weeks for power ups. The game is no different from online gambling. It rewards you to a point, then makes it impossible to clear levels, no matter how many coins and power ups you have, without purchasing more. This is absolutely a pattern that forces you to pay, in my experience, up to $30 a month. Great fun, as long as you expect to pay $$$.

A match 3 that doesn't match the ads. I downloaded this game because I thought saving the king was a good twist to yuor usual match 3 game. However, these instances are far between, and not the basis of the game. It is otherwise similar to any other match three where the more you play, the less likely you can pass the levels without spending money.

I have been playing this game for over 2 years & I have to say, you definitely have to PAY to get anywhere in this game. Also, this app is a hacker's delight. The unreal top scores of players or perhaps AI-created players. I'm in the Royal League so I know this game. 100% true. No matter what they say at DREAM GAMES, LTD. I've tested the algorithms. Recent update with a new "ooops", you go to move a tile & it doesn't go where you want it & you think it's your fault. It's not, I play w/ stylus.

Overall, this game has a nice design. The game is programed to keep you from getting to certain point unless you buy something. If you have extra coins or boosters the game will keep you from winning so that you can't accumulate more. It's really sad how they rig these games to try and make you spend money! I am on level 1013 and have been playing this game for a while now. I just wish it was more random and not programed to try and make you spend money to get anywhere!

Duration of Play: 3 months Experience: 4 🌟 out of 5 This was the most money I have spent on in-app purchases. However, it was the most fun I have had on a cellphone video game. I loved the ad-free play. I happened to join a top team and got lots of team rewards as a result. I uninstalled it when it became impossible to advance without spending lots of money.

Game is really fun and addictive, but the developers purposely make it so some levels are impossible to beat for a certain amount of tries in an attempt to get you to spend money on extra lives and power ups. Certain levels are easy and can pass first try, other levels you spend 15+ tries to get past and it's the same every time as the odds for power ups have to be stacked in your favour as there isn't enough moves to be able to pass it without them

Ok so I love the game, very addicting. Not so great parts, you have to spend money to advance in the game, there's no way around it. Also, the bonus power ups and bonus lives that come with a time limit run out whether you are playing the game or not. For example, you can get 6 hours of free lives but you only play for an hour and then go to bed, when you wake up, those free lives are gone because it's been 6 hours, even though you werent playing for 6 hours

Doesn't work like it's advertised, with mini-games. Game isn't offline either, as advertised, when you reach Garden you have to log onto internet to download. Once you log in, new features are installed, which are all online. Game increases excessive in size once updated, to 745mb, nearly 1Gig. Taking up space on device. Moves run out quick on some levels & hearts take too long to regenerate. Had to uninstall due to game size

the game started off pretty basic and gets more difficult as expected. I went back n forth between a 3☆ or 4☆ rating for 2 reasons: 1. they have teams as an available option, other than asking for donations of an extra lives in team chat, I don't see any benefit. 2. there are levels (most levels,as you get higher) that are impossible to pass without spending real money or just playing it for days. This is very discouraging! I have come really close to deleting it many times. yet it's fun......

The ads for this game in other games is entire WAY TOO LONG. Seriously, I only downloaded and played it JUST to give it one star because of the ads. Once I played it, I found it to be about as fun as every other match game in existence. I got to level 400 in 4 days, and then uninstalled because it was repetitive and boring. Not worth the hype the ads even gave it.

Nothing like the adds where you save the king. That is the only reason I downloaded this game. I deleted/ uninstalled at level 2. I'm not putting money into a game to be able to pass each level. You only get so many moves and that's where I draw the line. I want to play a game to unwind at end of night. Not get ticked off because I cant beat the game in 20 moves like it requires for every level. Do not recommend.

Game play is nothing like the ads, and once you've played enough levels (one puzzle per level) every third or fourth level is so hard that you either have to spend $$ or play the level over and over again and hope to get lucky enough to get by it. If you like bait and switch advertising and playing the same puzzle hundreds of times, this is the game for you! Also, the game is algorithm driven. You win when it wants you to win, and you lose when it wants - regardless of the boosts you have!

No ads mean you have to purchase anything you want extra. Moves, power ups. things to move the game along. You do get rewards for the completed quest, but they are not generous enough to help very often. Coins are a big thing. 900 to get 5 more moves and will go up to a total of 35 more moves. This is, of course, going to cost real-world money to purchase to complete the level. The coin rewards for level completion are laughable.

Pros 1. Game is fun 2. Graphics are great 3. No ads 4. Lots of challenges Cons 1. Game is not as advertised, save the king levels are few 2. Levels of the game become so difficult to pass even w/ bonus items 3. Winnings are few in comparison to how much it costs to continue to play. Ex. if you run out of turns you can get 5 more for 900 coins. Or w/ bonus items you can purchase 3 for 1900-3600 coins. 4. You have to complete a lot of things on one level w/ a few turns. Sadly going to uninstall

This game was fun, but they definitely have gotten greedy lately and have upped the difficulty level to where you have to spend money to get anything close to what you got before. I still play on occasion and then quickly remember why I have lessoned the play. I think the company would make decent money if they incorporated adds and went back to the way it was. System also seems more buggy. From bonuses going missing to executing moves and not getting what's expected.

Played this game for a few weeks. The ads are NOT like the game at all. It requires you to match tokens to then build your castle. Hardly ever got to 'rescue the King' & needed to buy (didn't) coins to get ahead. Don't get this game - total waste of time, and you don't want to watch the long frequent ads. Deleted the game.

Meh. The propellers go after blocks that don't help you, instead of going after the most difficult obstacles. Matching a super ball with TNT only damages at one hit...make that make sense. Sometimes the power boosters are more of a hindrance. Too many stupid games in between. I shouldn't have to spend 15 minutes putting together stupid puzzles to get prizes when I have more than enough pieces to win, for example.

Highly addictive and you can certainly be free-to-play for at least the first thousand levels. Transactions will be tempting, but if you've played match-3 type games before you shouldn't need to break into your wallet. The game rewards you for keeping a win streak and will offer you many opportunities to earn in-game currency and power-ups/boosters. My review is shy of 5 stars due to false advertisements if you saw the ads first. If there are any levels like the ads, they're likely much later.

I got to level 37 and then uninstalled. The puzzles themselves are boring up to this level, not at all like the ads I was watching in Wordscapes, in which you save the king. Up to now I have multiple goals to break plates, break boxes, mow a lawn, and collect mail. Success is random luck. If you fail any goal and do not have enough cash, it forces you to either purchase power ups or wait, say 30 m, before you can restart. With multiple tries to get past a hard level, it is infuriating.

Just deleted for the second. Thought i would try it out again, but I realized why I deleted it in the first place! The game was fun in the beginning, then gets redundant, and the levels get harder and harder to beat. I have spent days trying to get past a single level. There are very few challenges like what you see in the ads, and you have to beat a lot of levels to even unlock them. "F" THIS GAME!

The game is designed to hook you, then make you spend money to keep playing. Stops being fun after level 2500. I've also noticed a patern on the weekend. I'll play and win a handful, but lose the majority of my games. Then the last flew hours to play on Sunday, I'll win more, but not enough to win any good prizes. If you wanna spend money, with out getting anything back, this is your game.

This is quite possibly the most blatant pay to win game out there. Everything costs coins, and the amount of coins you win from a game is nothing compared to how much the powerups, lives, and additional moves cost. You may win 50 coins from a level, but if you don't beat it on the first try you have to pay 900 to keep going. Then 1,900 and so on. If you fail a level, you are punished even further for not spending the coins to keep going. It's designed to keep you behind and either pay, or lose.

Just wanted to say it's at least like the ad...too soon to give a higher rating and considering how much a lot of these game apps are known to disappoint, I'm gonna give this 1 at least 2, so far I like how it is exactly as advertised, which is something you can't say about any other app, having to constantly exaggerat simply to get people to download, if the games were as fun as the actual advertisements, there'd be no reason to lie, people would actually be more willing to download.

It's a typical match game. My biggest issue is, after the first few extremely easy levels it becomes almost impossible to pass any level without mass special items. Some regular levels take up 20 tries to pass. Then there are hard and super hard levels. That have taken 50 to 60 tries to get past. It quickly turns into a pay to play game if you want to get anywhere. I do enjoy a certain level of difficulty as most do. But this is absolutely ridiculous.

I enjoy this app mostly because they are generous with bonuses, and the levels get appropriately challenging with a variety of bonus games in between. I've been playing for years now and still find it entertaining and consistently glitch free. Also, you can play offline without wifi, and that progress will be saved. You just can't get additional lives until you're online again.

0 starts if I could, honestly matching games like this are a dime a dozen this one is nothing special. I played an event for an hour (the whole duration of the event) and when I went to go collect my reward it said I had only completed 1 level when I reached out to get support on this issue I was told "You have to stay online when playing events." My data was on and connected the whole time it was not an issue on my end but I'm not going to be cheated. Players deserve better.

Fun at first but like any other puzzle game these days after a certain point it's play to win. Even if paying after a certain point it will drain you of hundreds if you let it. Had over 10k coins built up, had boosters and the the game just kept draining it. Even at the end of each round you'd almost beat it and magically that special item would come up to help you win... But it cost! And that's how they suck in you. Meh - uninstalled.

I had enjoyed playing this game for ages (approaching 11.5k levels), even though it's never been precisely as advertised. It was fun, no ads, kinda relaxing, though frustrating at times & I even spent the odd few €. But, as of the last update, the coin rewards have been HALVED almost across the board, making the game infuriatingly hard & much, much less fun. I'll stick it out for a little longer for the sake of my team full of decent people, but unless something's given back, I'm out!

I use to play this game incessantly a few years ago. HOWEVER, after a few months I noticed that whenever the game made the choice of which object to take out on my behalf, it would consistently choose the color or object least favorable to me. Normally I would've let it fly, HOWEVER, I was dumping money into the app for coins and then realized it was rigged against me. Sounds like hoodoo, but check it out. It cheats you.

It starts off as enjoyable but then gets stupid hard really quickly. 900 coins to get 5 extra moves is far too many as winning a level may not even get you 100 coins. You will need to spend money to be able to win levels after a certain point but it's questionable as to whether or not it is worth it. Levels are so hard that you may need as many as 35 tries to pass 1 level. Too much effort, not enough reward

I really enjoyed the game, but, when you are a higher lvl you need boosters to actually win. I feel the train journey and the odessey events are annoying. I have never finished even one of those events. The lvls are just to difficult. The rewards are not that satisfying either. It's great that there are no ads in the game. That is about the only plus of the game. It is starting to feel just like candy crush saga, which I uninstalled because I need to play a lvl nearly 300 times just to beat it.

This game is highly deceptive making levels easy initially to get you "hooked", then the game's primary focus becomes money. They structured levels to become impossible to beat until the moment you spend between 9-1800 coins. Suddenly then you beat it easily. The coins are ridiculously expensive and slow to collect. You get a mere 5 lives (which they make sure you burn through quickly) and have to wait hours until it refills unless you buy more. It becomes far more irritating than fun. Pass!

You DO get levels to SAVE THE KING ... eventually. Not sure when they start. It's not right off the top. And by the time you do get them ... well. I'm only fast enough if I'm not watching him. Teams give you extra lives. If you beat one level you get 30 minutes of unlimited lives. If you do the daily "challenge" or whatever, you get an hour of unlimited lives. All levels are solvable. Often quick, others I try *many* times before I find the right approach. Spent $0, 3k levels so far.

This game is a money maker. Get a super light ball and you will rarely get one in a game unless you bring it with you to start. The hints don't help you so don't waste your moves using them. You can only win if you spend money. The levels trap you in a corner where you spend too many moves just to get out of the stupid corner. The game used to be fun. It has turned into a money maker and is no longer fun anymore. I do not recommend it. unless you are ok with spending $ to win. Removed it.

I installed this game about a week ago and really enjoyed it at first. I've even spend a little bit of money playing it because I was enjoying it so much. I'm already around level 450 and it's gotten to the point that the regular levels take playing 10+ times to complete and the hard and super hard levels are almost impossible. It's clear that the devs have created this game to be nearly impossible without buying power-ups or extra moves. It's no longer fun and I am uninstalling the game.

You can play first ~150 levels for free, and then the levels become increasingly complicated, so that it is almost impossible to pass without boosters, forcing you to spend money. I don't mind spending some money, but the way they implemented it (you fail the level 10+ times, get angry, and then you must spend the money, or you're stuck) is frustrating. Also number of lives is limited to 5.. and after failing for 5 times, you must either pay, or wait for 2.5 hours. Not fun.

Not as advertised. I keep seeing ads that make this look like there are fun unique levels such as moving jewels to get the king to a certain place on the other side. So far it's just like bejeweled (just a square level and you have to clear boxes), plus building something? I don't see the point in adding something to build. Also if I wanted to play something like bejeweled I would just play bejeweled or candy crush.

This game has one of the highest and worse algorithms to make you lose, no matter how good you are. After level 2000 the game no longer works based on skill, it changes to beating levels design to make you fail, use your coins or powerups. I've played this game from level 1 to 10,000 only to see over and over again, the same story from other players and myself. Go back to candy crush where at least you knew you had to spend.

Levels become way too hard. I was on level 2625 when I'd finally had enough and un-installed the game. Multiple times, one level could take me a week to get past. It shouldn't be this hard. It was no longer fun.It had become frustrating. Games are supposed to be fun. I think they probably do it to get you to spend more money. Too bad because it is a fun game.

This game is disgustingly fun. My dissatisfaction comes with the pay to play mentality. It's almost as if the developers forgot how to have fun. A puzzle that shouldn't be difficult suddenly is, and the option to buy buy buy is before you. I play another match 3 game by Zynga who used to operate this way, but have since changed to a more player friendly format. There are more chances to gain power ups and infinite time; there are more rewards of higher value. This game is good but it needs work.

Not exactly as advertised. 5 levels in and it's nothing like the ads. There is no trying to save the king on a time limit. If there is I haven't seen it yet in 5 levels and is the only reason I wanted to try it. Even if it is a level or 2 where it is like the ads, that is too infrequent for why I downloaded it. Otherwise not a terrible game as is. Good graphics and is just like every other match game. Really East at first. I saw reviews about how le els become impossible later

Okay, so... read the one-star reviews for sure... don't buy anything. Once you buy any coin or power up packages, they change the algorithm so that you lose until you need to buy more packages to keep playing. It was fun before. Now it's a forced transaction rip. I was playing hours at a time and buying the monthly upgrade package for a few months, but it's gotten to the point where the algorithm switch is very obvious. I don't want to play anymore and thought I'd review before deleting.

Poorly scripted game, you know what I mean if you've played enough . The "normal" level is suddenly really hard for no reason and you have to spam retry until the game drop power-up randomly while playing. (Losing a level makes you lose all the event progress). And forced power-up after winning a level is sometime ruin the beginning set-up.

Fun Game! But.... I used to LOVE this game! It has cute graphics and LOTS of levels (6,000+ at this point). I've played for FAR too many hours & spent far too much money on boosters (I've cleared all the levels so far). However, for the past few weeks it seems like the algorithm is set so that you HAVE to pay money for extra turns to clear every. single. level. It's become incredibly frustrating & expensive rather than fun. I'm looking for another game.

The game is fun to play, but is just another money pit. To retry a level you have to pay 900 coins and you get an average 50 coins per level that you beat. You can do the math on how many levels you have to beat WITHOUT FAIL in order to get enough coins to buy just one retry and even then, you only get 5 more moves to complete the level. If you don't spend the 900 coins, you lose ALL of the tools you've built up. I'm really disappointed that several actors sold out to promote this game.

I really enjoyed trying to save the king, but I was annoyed with having to decorate/furnish the castle to get to that part of the game. I'm not a gamer, so when I bother to download a game, I want to play what was advertised and not jump through hoops to get to that part. Just my opinion. I'm sure others love it. I would have as well if it were just saving the king. In fact, I'd even pay a small fee if it were just savi g the king and no ads.

Nothing like the ad and not entirely free. If you want to win, alot of the time you'll have to buy extra things just to barely win. It could have been a fun game but who has this much money ... granted you aren't made to buy anything but if you plan on winning you will have to pay. This game is not entirely the same as the ad... same character but thats about it

Endless and repetitive. Playing it feels like washing dishes. I was fine with that for a while (it relaxed my mind), but then the devs lowered the rewards you receive for completing hard and very hard levels (in order to force you into buying coins), and it just wasn't worth the time anymore. On a positive note, there are no ads, so that is nice.

I played the game once. Not absolutely terrible, but I really hate the ads. They are annoyingly long, like this comment would be if I wasn't stopped at 500 characters; they are partially false, like my ex's teeth; and they keep coming, even though I've already stated I'm done with them and I don't like them, much like a stalker you were once interested in, but decided nah, and who doesn't understand personal boundaries. STOP SHOWING ME THESE ADS, I PLAYED YOUR GAME ONCE, WE AREN'T A THING!!

Fun and no ads, but... The game initially is very fun, but it quickly gets difficult. Although it's ad free, if you want to keep going you will spend some cash. If not, its nearly impossible to make progress. Sometimes you can get great help from support while other times, the majority of the time, you are given a canned reply with not much interest in addressing the issue. They can be very dismissive. I will stick around to help other players, but I will no longer be a consistent player.

Out of the gate - it's not the game play that advertised. There is no saving the king as advertised and that's afyer playing this to 213 levels. It's a no skill game that eventually increases in difficulty until you have no choice but to pay for the upgrades needed to complete the levels. Additionally, you only get so many tried before it makes you wait a half hour to play again. It's just too cheesy of a game to also be this lame.

I found the game very enjoyable until I reached higher levels. I have anxiety, this game seemed to help ease it some. I do not like that the game is staged to make you want to buy stuff to get to another level. Very disappointed in that. Don't advertise the game as free if people can't play the game without spending money. You should make bonus levels to buy into to get extra tools and whatnot. Get your money that way and leave the regular play alone.

Very boring. I don't require a story to play a game. I play games that require a lot of concentration. Adding a story doesn't make the game itself any more interesting. It may have no ads, require no WiFi etc, but asking for money is no better, especially when it's about 10 minutes into the game 👎👎👎 Bad rating! As already said, very boring.

When are devs going to learn that if we had any interest in your game after 30 seconds of an ad, we lose all interest after having to sit through your 2-3 minute ads interrupting the games we actually do want to play. There are so many games I might have played if I wasn't annoyed by their long ads in other games. This one happens to be the worst offender. I won't play it, or recommend it because of this.

Warning- This game is a rip-off! Most of the fun little levels they advertise DO NOT exist. They trap you into making you spend money! I've played over 11,000 levels in this game and it started out being fun, but they raise the prices of the coin packages without notice!Also, Once you get a streak going, the game works against you so that you either have to buy more moves or lose your streak and all the rewards you've built up! Please, for the sake of your sanity, PICK A DIFFERENT GAME TO PLAY.

The game is not free!! The game is programed that there are levels that there is only 1 sequence that will allow u to finish with out boosters & it is one of thousands of combinations & could take months before it is put into que. After 4-5 days on the same level it stops being fun. My review is skip this game and find another that will allow u to actually play, as stated for free & not written that the only way past a level is to spend money.

FINALLY A GAME WITH NO ADS!!!!!!! Only bad thing. When you fail to complete a level, it gives you the option to continue playing with a certain amount of moves, but the price is stupid. For 5 more moves, it's literally 900 coins. That may not be a problem for veteran players who have been playing the game long enough to be loaded, but for newer players, it drains your bank. It's very frustrating when you can literally win in a move. Please fix it. Also, a match 3 game, not a save the king game:)

Decided to give this game another try, waste of time and energy. Defeated a level, got free 30 minutes. Burned through that and the 5 lives. Then did the lightning round, another hour trying to get through level. Lost count at over 40 tries, know though that 9 times just needed 1 more move at 900 coins to pass level. when I fi ally got through, 16 coins reward and no time left. If you play this game, better off hitting your toe into furniture.

The game is fun,I get stuck on a level,and it's rediculous how hard some of the levels are,it mite take a week for me to wait,playing,to pass a level,if you watch,the power ups ( that u actually earn)cheat!,and I play only with what I earn,I don't buy anything, I think that is cheating, I just wish that the levels were like all the same hardness so you could actually enjoy the game instead of getting stuck for a week on one level and be so discouraged,and now I'm about to look elsewhere,to pass⏳

I installed this game thinking, based on the ads, that the goal is to rescue the king. WRONG! I played through the entire first area and started the second. This is just another (bad) knockoff of Garden Scape. There is no rescuing anyone. All you do is decorate different areas of the castle. Very disappointing. Deleting.

The game has very little to do with skill, and is very much regulated by RNG. They also structure the game to ensure that some levels can only be beaten with power items, and they all but force you to purchase items if you wish to proceed. I refuse to buy anything. It is a fun concept, but the execution and algorithms are designed to extract money from you.

It's an OK match game. Nothing crazy cool, not horrible. It's just ok. My big issue is that the "King's Nightmare" sections are what are shown in the ads, but they're nothing like the actual game play. The real game play is just a timed match 3 game. You don't get to interact with the dream like in the ads. Lost a star for false advertising.

Purely from a gameplay, I'd give this game four or five stars. Unfortunately, that is overshadowed by the lotto-style manipulation. The levels start easy, but by level 20+ they're nigh on impossible to beat first try without great luck - or, of course, real money. Of course you only have 5 lives which return very slowly, to encourage you to spend. Every event has some way to force you to spend money and make you think it was your idea. Playing this is like shopping while hungry; just don't!

Greedy, predatory game developers. The ads for this game ALWAYS OPEN AUTOMATICALLY on news sites/apps without me touching anywhere near the ad. I wanted to blame the news app/site before I realized, NO, IT'S ONLY ROYAL MATCH ADS THAT OPEN AUTOMATICALLY. The game is just okay, I only played some. I honestly only downloaded it so I could call them out on this absolute BS advertising campaign they have going on, but it sounds like from other reviews the game itself is a cash-grab.

Ok - I really love this game, however I'm VERY close to uninstalling it! What's going on? Is this going to be an ongoing issue? I've worked too hard to get those amounts!!! Veronica Ligon Profile name: Trainerchick

I've been playing this game for about a year now. It's fun. However, it is not as advertised. The ads state that you are saving the king, that almost never happens. I'm on level 1362 and haven't seen anything like that in over a hundred levels. You can't win anymore without power up and every other level is either hard, or super hard. Even the non hard levels can take days to win no matter how many power ups you use. False advertising in my opinion. I'm about to dump the app and mov

At first this game was fun. After Hours of waiting for the time to reset to be able to get free lives i changed my mind about this game. You purchase some lives and the game gets ridiculously complicated and makes you loose the lives you purchased too fast. All they want is your money. I noticed it only allows you to pass the level after you finally purchase some lives otherwise it takes too long to pass it.

I watched hundreds of ads for this game, with a skeezy car salesman telling me its the best game ever, there are no ads, and to let him know if he's wrong about the game. Since there is obviously no way to contact this actor to tell him he was wrong, I'm writing the review instead. This game is basically another version of Candy Crush or Homescapes. Its true that there are no ads, but what they don't tell you is that it becomes impossible to progress in the game unless you pay for boosters.

This game is greedy and misleading. It starts off easy, but quickly becomes hungry for your wallet. None of the levels you see in the ads are in the actual game and the levels are nearly impossible unless you use every power up you can buy or have insane luck. Towards level 200, ylthey give you 2 rows to work with, if your lucky, and anywhere from 60 to 150 objectives to break most of which require special tiles or multiple hits with only 15 moves.

Installed for 5 points. Seen ads several times. Game nothing like advertised. Just a candy crush clone but at least the levels I played weren't drowning in ads. However, it isn't really a "game" since if you hesitate for even a second, it will just tell you the best move to make, eliminating the already non-existent challenge. If you like Candy Crush, you might like this game. Personally, I'm annoyed by the fake advertising.

The game is a fraud, the short clips they show you and spokesman they use is so full of it. They make the game impoosible to play. Spent money and the game is still impoosible. Been on same level for 4 days and spent money buying power ups and still will not let you by. So its a waste of time and money. Don't download this game unless you want to throw away money.

I like playing this game but I refuse to pay for anything...You really need to tell people who want to play that it is going to cost money..you cannot pass levels unless you pay.. The game becomes impossible to pass levels so you get stuck playing one level for days... and you can't restart the game....I have been on the same level for 3 weeks. Very difficult!!!!!

I played this game with many of the warning reviews in mind. Yes it's great that it's ad free but, they need to make the lost revenue up some how. You have an easy go of it until level 190-195. Then it's constant buy extra lives to finish. The bonuses do diminish as the game progresses. Typical same old same old as most games. I held off the reciew till I had a chance to get into it. Yeah pay attention to the forewarning reviews. Many of them are on point.

I've been playing this game 2+ years. used to be great, NOW, ITS NOT GOOD AT ALL!! over the last few weeks all the rewards have diminished and the levels are increasingly hard to the point you cannot win unless you purchase. Taken the fun out of it. the creator's have really messed up, it's all only about making more money for them now. I'm out😮‍💨 no more $$ from me.

Have personally never played a single second of this game but the ads that continuously keep popping up throughout my favourite game that I started playing about an hour ago (which is definitely not this game, let me tell you) piss me off. I downloaded the game just so I could write a review. I'm just trying to enjoy building my hotel and all of a sudden this stupid king keeps popping up on the screen. Also, the graphics are not as good as the lads in the ad want to make it seem. Thank you :)

So... The levels shown in the ads are there. They're called "King's Nightmare". They seem to be every 10th level. But my god, the other 9 levels to get there? I hate it. Super boring match 3 levels. Each level gives you a star (to build the castle) and coins (for power-ups). I only like the King's Nightmares levels. The ads make you think the whole game is like that - I wish it was. I want a full game where that poor king is being tortured and you have to save him!

Don't play this game, if you have any type of budget! Every purchase you make will set the game up to take all of your coins. 900 coins to continue, but you only get 25 back when you complete the level. Also, I've actually seen it add your points wrong. Takes 3 wins to get the butlers extra "help", but puts them on the board to set you up to not make any extra moves, and when you decide to replay the level, and not use your coins....takes away ALL of the 3 "helpers" at once. BIG FRAUD!!!!

Why does it say that I have no more moves & that I need to pay when I clearly have some fantastic moves left? It just did it again, so I paid your dues & completely blew the entire board in just 1 move! It's also disappointing that it's pretty much a "Bejeweled" type game vs. "Saving the King." The King is rarely actively present in the levels. There are also no decorating options. You can only choose from what's there. You can't even choose a color of anything. I was bored by a few levels in :/

Gave 2 because it is a good game to kill time. But it set up, so you have to purchase coins. They make it so hard for 30 to 40 trys to make you purchase. If you don't purchase and you have tried over 30 times, they then make it too easy. I just don't have that kind of money to spend. Un-installed but wanted to share if it is helpful to others

BEWARE! Great game.... But as you get to the higher levels, the super hard are just that. It's frustrating to play it over and over and just keep losing. Then the ad to buy coins which you know will get you thru until the next super hard challenge. Sadly same complaint by so many. I'm not going to waste money when everything is so expensive right now to get thru a level. This one's on my chopping block.

I'm well versed in match-3s and thought 'saving the king' would be a different sort of puzzle. Alas, the ads are misleading. Consider this a 2.5; It's a cute game, smooth graphics but the decor is hardly a progression reward. If you want a challenging match-3 that lets you decorate your board, play Matchington Mansion. This game just made me crave that instead.

This game sucks unless you like spending money. There are no adds! Because in order to play you've got to buy things or your game will end. I've been playing for about 20 minutes. I've rescued the king one time in a short "get water" to the fire game! Nothing at all like the adds! If you like spending money on items that will enable you to continue to play, this is the game! They sell the game making you think you'll be rescuing the king! NOPE! One time in 20 minutes! Save your $! This SUCKS !!!

My opinion is the same as other players who gave 1 star. This game is basically pay-to-win. I don't mind paying as i know companies need profits and developers need income; however, even if i paid, i cannot enjoy the gaming experiences for long. Also, I have the same feeling (based on multiple experiences) that they have sophisticated algorithm to counter your effort to solve the puzzle. That made me very frustrated and disappointed when i was playing the game.

It's a beautiful game. The graphics are smooth and well animated. Craftsmanship is top notch, but, just like Candy Crush, you pass level 100 and the levels become purposely generated to make people want to pay money to get further. Believe me I am happy to offer money to a well made game like this one, but not when it makes it almost impossible to advance without doing so. Multi-hit boxes covering multi-hit grass while trying to break other things that conveniently drop midway through the level.

I like the fact that this game has no ads but over the course of 2 days I spent 20 bucks on add ons and it was sucked up like water and didn't really pay me to advance the game. I feel that should have at least lasted a few days but it didnt. Kind of disappointed. Its like all they want is you to keep buying thier packages and not give you anything for it.

Game is fun. I do enjoy playing it. But as you get up the higher levels they don't make it easy without actually purchasing item to help you compete levels. I am going on 4 days trying to bet one level, if I don't beat it by tomorrow, unfortunately i will be deleting the app cause I hate apps that make the game easy when you first get it to keep you attach. But once you are in, don't make it easy without spending money. Others might be happy spending money, but oj smart phone games, I just don't

Heard about this game though numerous ads. Looked like fun.... Been on about 3 wks.... It's a very progressive game. Once you make that 1st purchase at $1.99, it just progresses from there. As for the game itself? It's intriguing...at 1st, but once you learn how to play.... It's addicting.... You can expect when you will lose.... so it gets old.... if you see the pattern. I've only been playing 3-4 wks... Don't waste your time.

I have been playing this game for some time. I am almost on level 9000. It is very annoying that the levels are nothing like the ones in the ads that are blasted at me all the time even though I have not only downloaded the game but have also been playing for so long. it is also almost impossible to earn coins and it is so expensive to buy coins. Also unlike other games they dont gift you anything on your birthday or for Christmas etc.

Fun at first until you reach a certain level. They made it so that once you buy any game package, you start failing badly. So you will keep on buying to win. You cannot progress unless you pay real money. Which is not that bad but the problem is that you cannot pass ANYMORE levels unless you pay. Now how much are you willing to spend per level? So if you have enough dough to ravish, go ahead. If not stay away from this money grab.

Enough with the super hard levels. Literally every other or in succession it's a super hard level. It was fun at first. You get lots and lots of freebies, but I'm at the point where I'm literally about to uninstall. It's just like any other money grabbing match 3 game. It's getting old. A little challenge is fun but when you get to the point you have to spend real money or literally go through all your freebies that it gets scummy.

I'll admit this is a fun and addictive game. The main selling point is that it has "no ads" so you can just play. Because there are no ads the game becomes VERY difficult after you complete the early levels. When I say difficult I mean that you will quickly get to a level THAT IS LITERALLY IMPOSSIBLE TO WIN without paying. I have no intention of paying in a game whose main selling point is that it is free, so I just can't play anymore. Very disappointing. I think I would preferred ads.

False advertising. This app implies that a character is escaping impending doom while you, the player, solve puzzles to save or rescue them. In reality, that is not how the game plays at all. The gameplay is completely different from what is advertised. It promotes one experience but delivers something entirely else. This app is highly misleading. Do not download it based on the advertisement—you will not get what you expect.

"Dream Games has raised $255 million. The company behind the hit gaming title “Royal Match,” is now valued at $2.75 billion" It's definitely a rip-off. The developers are filling up their pockets, while we, the gamers, spend $$$ trying to beat this game. There's never going to be an end because more rooms are added up, and the difficulty to beat them gets bigger and increasing your money spending. I recommend staying away before you see yourself spending your hard-working money. Not worth it!

Very quickly, you will get to levels that are impossible to beat unless you pay for bonus turns and upgrades. It was fun for about 2 weeks. Now, it's just tedious and impossible to win levels without spending money. Additionally, all the ads show are levels where you rescue the king. 90% of the levels are not what is shown. Very misleading.

Although there are no ads, the developer regularly includes levels that cannot be passed without purchasing item packages. The game is very repetitive and the randomness of some levels make this more like gambling with no payout. Not worth the time or effort, and I refuse to give them money. I'd rather deal with ads for short term gains

Started fun, ended horrible. I got pretty high on the levels, but the higher I got, the harder it got, I started to notice that this game is designed the higher the levels, the more it is set up for a player to lose. It has became obvious the last 10 levels, just one move needed to win, hit the helicopter, and it lands on something way off. For example, it takes me days to win just one level. This is just another game that just wants your money. Very sad...

Would have kept playing if it wasn't another money grab. The puzzles get to a point to being impossible to solve without the game pressuring you into purchasing. I don't mind spending a few bucks here or there on games, I've spent quite a bit over the years. But I will not play a game that corners you into buying in order to advance. The only other option is to play the waiting game for energy to build just to attempt the impossible all over again. 2 stars would of been more.

This game lied. I installed it, as it looked fun. That was the first lie. Advertising no ads, in the game, was the second lie. The levels featured in the ad to suck you into installing it, don't even appear during gameplay. That was the third. I played until level 178. The game has forced me to use my coins (11847 is where I was at when I reached level 178, and, 421 is what I have left) and I used all my power ups, and I still didn't pass the level. Brutal. Uninstalled and done with Dream games

This game's advertisement is completely misleading. What is shown in the advert is entirely different from what you get after downloading. The gameplay has nothing to do with saving the king as portrayed — it's just an ordinary tile-matching game. The level of deception is disappointing. Honestly, the game doesn’t even deserve a one-star rating due to the false advertising.

I was so ready to give this game 10 stars and the BEST review I've ever given a game, for its creativity, outstanding graphics, challenging levels and superb gamesmanship, until I got deeper into the game, and that's when you get suckered punched, with what I thought set this game apart from others. Then, you reach that level that wants your money OR you will go no further until you spend some in order to advance...Well that just breaks my heart for I thought this game was above punking people .

Complete bait & switch garbage. First of all, it's advertised as a match 3 game where you make matches to save the king from dying. It's not! Those type of levels only come along every once in a while in the game. For the most part it's just another run of the mill match 3 game. Worse, it's a 'build' game where you landscape & decorate the 'royal' kingdom depending upon your success in the preceding match 3 level. It's a grind & it's boring. So MANY better match 3 games out there. Uninstalled.

I love the game, and what would make it even better is to add features like add friends without have to create account with socials, to be able to sent coins to teammates (if you saved and have some, but your teammate none, so you can help out),also do not limit request❤ up to 15❤, let it be 5 at a time every 3 hours as it is now, but no limit how many ❤you can receive, does that make sense? 🙂idk what do you think? This game is fun at beginning but as levels progress & get tougher, bonuses become sparse. Need to buy coins & such to get extra bonuses. Add poor game design for when you fail a level, the "Continue for 900 coins" button is in the middle of screen which can easily be hit by mistake. Don't waste time or money

Fun at first... then it becomes very difficult beyond level 150. You NEED to use the power ups in order to complete the levels, and even then you end up using all of them up trying to complete the level in the limited amount of moves given. In other words, you gotta spend a lot of money if you want to progress in this game... bummer.

Every time we update this game we get more an more bugs in it, game takes over an hour to start, stuck on "dream", Where's the fun in that when the updates suppose to be fun has you the developers say? Fun and pathetic. This game is most definitely fun but one major flaw makes it pathetic. It cheats! As you climb the levels and the difficulty increases the game steers far from its random drops that will require you to have to make purchases in order to advance. Drops clearly become manipulated and your ability to make matches doesn't exist without making a purchase. At times the matching of colors fails to award the explosive drop. Everything about this game becomes manipulated . Game sucks!

False advertising. Save the King. Except that's not what you are really doing. This games a rip off. If you want to pay for everything, this games for you. If you are looking for free games this isn't it. Gives you lots of coin and items at the beginning. But very quickly you can't win a single game without using something. Its unnecessarily hard. The items and coin dwindle down quickly. If I could give it a zero I would.

I loved this game at first. I play a lot of games like this and love a challenge. This game gets you hooked and then bam! You can't get past levels unless you buy in. I understand buying in, and they have to make money. I have no issues with that. I have bought a few packages myself. What I do have issues with is when you get to a point you can't move forward at all unless you buy in. They make some levels so hard you have no choice.

Good while it last. Then after a while, no matter what your skill level are, you will find yourself starting to spend money in order to keep passing as the penalty of failing a level is large when you have boosters on. Meaning once they run out for any reason, it will cost you many life or attempt to pass it again. But I cannot say it's all bad. They advertised exactly as they said. But you will have to pay for the benefit you got. Maybe that's just even as you can't just get things for nothing

Got stuck on level 157 for two months so i uninstalled and found the next game to play. There is no logic needed to solve the levels it's more or less chance you need in order to beat them. I would say maybe at least 20 times I came close to beating level 157 but I think it was designed to get you to spend money to beat it. To bad I did like the game. Even though it's falsely advertised.

I got this game because I saw a review about it being "ad free" and I kept getting ads for it. So I downloaded it and yes you don't get ads. However, in the ads it's always like "save the king from a fire breathing dragon" or "save the king from drowning" and if you're looking for a game like that, don't download this one. I thought every level would be saving the king, but you ib only got to save him once from a small fire in his castle. You're not saving him, you're decorating for him.

Three stars because the game is fun! WARNING you will continually lose your coins and spend money as you reach the higher levels. They don't reward you with enough coins or anything else after your wins. Constant challenges that go on at the same time with some taking days to claim low rewards, so you KEEP spending money. I've spent too much money and time completing thousands of levels like a FOOL. There are so many games you can play for fun without spending a dime & this isn't one of them!

Fun game for killing time, but under no circumstances give it any real money. Everything changed after that. Once I caved and purchased a packet in order to beat a level, the game became much harder. It purposely holds you back hoping that you will put more money into it. Like I said, it's a fun game until you give it real money then every changes.

False advertising, which most people know about already. The first few levels are fine, but then the levels become impossible and you only get about 20-25 moves when you need about 50 to complete the level since some obstacles take 3-5 rounds to clear. When you have 60 obstacles that take 5 rounds...well...25 moves isn't enough, not even if you use every single power up, even multiples of them.

Not worth playing. Not as advertised. Only save the king when he's having a nightmare about every 50 levels. Once you spend your first dollar the game changes to where you can't pass anymore levels even the "easy" ones without spending money. Cust support knows this but just gives a generic default script about improving game play on future(lie). Don't fix their glitches and are only after your money. Play match frenzy instead. At least that really doesn't cost you anything and worth your time.

ive been playing. even beat all the levels before. but this time around the amount of coins you get as well as "power up" or whatever you call it does not match- meaning is just too little. I feel like they know if u purchase extras and then they do not offer you winnable situations so you have to end up purchasing more. im done spending my money.

Ad bait and switch.... The only reason I downloaded this game was due to the ads and saving the king. Well went through 50 levels and not a single level like that. Finally read the other reviews, and while it exists (those save the king levels) it is other rare or for some people only. So I deleted it. It is an exact clone of Toon Blast (or that is an exact clone of this game I don't know what came first), but regardless no save the king like all of the ads portray.

Update: 1 day was all it took for it to go from a fun and relaxing game to a stressful, upsetting game. The 1st time I couldn't complete a round, and couldn't pay the 900 coin price for extra time, they took away my butlers gifts, second time, they took away my books that I worked so for. You have to be rich to play. Original review: far I really like it. I hope it doesn't get impossibly hard like other games do. I want it for relaxation and will Uninstall the minute it becomes stressful.

I like the game especially without ads interrupting every level but in the end it's still just a money grab. You win very few coins in gameplay & spend 900 for an extra 5 moves then 1900, 2900...ect. And again 1900 for boosts. Somewhere around level 1500 if you don't spend real cash, it's almost impossible to advance. I'm tired of playing the same board 20+ times to advance. Maybe it's time for something else.

It is not what it appears to be, only a candy crush type game with very few puzzles. Plus, after a while you cannot pass hardly anything without paying. I went several hundred levels and finally stopped wasting my money. I'm only giving it 3 stars because until the hundreds levels you can earn enough extras to get through them, so at least you have awhile before it becomes ridiculous.

For me there is too much going on in this game. I like my games to be relaxing, this game is opposite. It bombards you. No story to give you time for thought. On the plus side it does not have ads instead it uses micro transactions. But you can seem to play a lot with no payment. If you are the type that can get addicted to gaming/gambling I would recommend passing on this game. Google does not allow me format this review nicely, it makes it one paragraph :(

I only downloaded this to say play store MUST be getting paid to recommend the games for saying they are free! Most of them ARE NOT free! Loved playing this and loved the graphics and capabilities but the levels went on forever! Pretty sure I didn't utilize all the tools and certainly didn't understand all the side games going on at the same time, nor why you have to pay money to get further ahead, who has money for that... Found that saving the King doesn't happen very often out of the many, many games played which was disappointing. I gave up at about level 8. Huge time waster!

It's a very good game except I can tell when it intentionally makes the game easier so you don't get too frustrated, but then it makes it harder so you'll be tempted pay to get further along. My teammates will drop $20 just to get a team bag of gold. Which is ridiculous. I refuse. I've bought a few items here and there, but I'm done doing that. I'll just keep playing 1000 times over until the algorithm gives me a break. If this game keeps frustrating me I'll drop it like a hot potato.

game started out really fun. I've been playing this game for a while now. I'm at level 3869 at the time of this review. The ads they show for this game is misleading. The kings nightmare isn't anything like the ads. My quick pro tip is to play the first few hundred levels and then delete the game. You'll get in a losing rut and the developers hope it's that you spend some money to get out of the losing streak. It's infuriating because when you play a few thousand levels, you know when you're going to lose. 👎👎

This game is nothing like the ads. This game is just your bog standard match 3 game. Every so often you get king's nightmare levels but instead of being a puzzle it's just another ordinary level only timed now instead. If you like match 3 games you'll know what to expect but if you're expecting something like the ads then you'll be disappointed.

The type of games you see in the ads is about every 10 levels it seems. The other games you play are match 3 but it requires you to get a certain number of items within a certain number of moves. I downloaded for the games in the ads, not whatever the rest is. I hate these that only give me a certain number of moves. As usual, the game is not what they portray in ads. Sad. Uninstalled.

The Ad for this is misleading! You think all the games are to save the King, which I thought that's what it was and I liked the idea!! The whole game is ok, but not what is being advertised!!! Very disappointed!!

I installed this game and I should have trusted the reviews. Not only does it do what ever 1 Star reviews say. Lure you in with ads showing at least some sense of purpose - ie, race against time to save the king from peril ... Only to find it's a ”decorate a castle by playing a candy crush style game”. Used to be fun. Now it's pay to play. The levels are so extreme at upper levels that it's loses touch with the gameplay. They've jumped the shark. After playing with the game for a long time ... Can be fun but you will spend money for that one last move to go forward. Loads of other side games to play if you have enough monies. Great time waster, few and far between mini games. Over all not bad. Just it can get frustrating stuck on a level for days and I usually have given in to buy a package just to get on with it. The game is fun at the beginning so you get hooked. Then it becomes harder and because you are hooked, you may start to buy stuff. This game is great and horrible all at the same time. It's great due to awesome graphics, fun game play, a variety of level structures, and no ads!. It's horrible because, since their only revenue is through in-game purchases, if you don't buy anything, you will have to repeatedly play levels up to +20 times over before you're allowed to pass. That gets old quick.

This game isnt like what the adds show,, its a match 3 game rather than puzzles. All the same,, it was fun at first but quickly turned into another insane money grabber. Some of he levels are next to impossible to beat without power ups, which are difficult to earn and quite expensive to buy. GAME STILL TOCKS

Ok but not great so far. Forces me into a review too early. Decorations are arbitrary, there's not even an illusion of choice. Slow animations. Seems to be a standard match 3 game while the ad made it look like it had puzzles, I haven't seen them yet. Will uninstall.

Fun colorful matching game experience .. match 3, 4, and 5 to clear colored tiles and beat levels. Lots of fun and user friendly. I just really wanted to see graphics and scenarios like in the ads. Just an excuse for some people to try and grab lots of money form lots of people. Don't download this unless you wanna spend a lot on power ups and stuff. First 50 levels or so, fair game. Its been a good run, well it was. I'm over it now. You've rigged it up well. Dang near every level is a hard level, and the actual hard levels are impossible. Oh let me tell you about this wonderful little annoyance called a game. It's not bad, I just wish it didn't push the IAPs so much. The levels get extremely difficult, which encourages you to spend irl money. I have yet to give in, but man is it tempting lol. So annoying.

Obvious manipulation of the game mechanics to maximize spending. Read the one star reviews; they are dead on. Uninstalled.

The game is OK but you'll get to a level where you'll need to buy something from the company to continue on. It's OK for a few days then the scam comes. Pay-to-Win Game, Not Worth Your Time My Review. This game is extremely disappointing. The difficulty is intentionally increased, making it nearly impossible to win without purchasing coins or premium items. The game prioritizes profit over providing a fair experience for all players. It crashed on me numerous of times and I finally decided to delete it. Better off playing toy blast candy crash ect... It was ok. The same as any other match game But not what was advertised all the way. I did get to play 2 games that did what was shown on the commercials. Fun but becomes clear who's really winning in this game! I expected a game where I would be trying to save the king from all kinds of situations, instead I'm playing a game to decorate a castle. Unfortunately this game is the best. At separating you from your money. Game runs great and has no ads, but has very bad RNG. It's especially noticeable when you have a puzzle with a limited number of starting pieces/matches. Later puzzles also are extremely restrictive with the starting # of moves.

Downloaded and installed so I can complain about your ridiculous ads everywhere. I love this game.. it's a lot of fun to play. it's another game that's fun and easy for the first couple hundred levels, then the algorithm changes. they have a loss requirement, unless you brute force it with power ups. instead of the levels getting more difficult, they mess with the block drop algorithm, so you don't get good block drops, forcing you to waste moves.

This is just another match game. I downloaded it because the "save the king" ads looked fun. Turns out this is exactly like all the rest of the matching games. Hey, I really love Royal Match, it's a masterpiece. But, there's one bug that made me put only 4 stars.... It's about the super light ball, it doubles the input of a normal light ball. Not sure how much longer I'm going to play this game. Use 900 coins for only 5 more moves in return for fraction if level is passed. Excellent 👌 game. I have not spent any money to pass 642 levels. I spent $1.60 (about that) for the 10'000 coins because it was there. If you get stuck, keep trying; sometimes levels take 10 or 20 attempts before you get a lucky draw. Take advantage of infinite lives on Mondays. I usually get through the 50 new levels (every two weeks) in a week witheut using any power-ups. Don't give up!

Installed in the hope that it would stop the unrelenting, breathless ads promoting a game with No Ads. Uninstalled at the stage when progress required spending actual money. It only took a few days. Spoiler alert: installing the game doesn't stop the truly cringeworthy ads. Wondering if it's possible to block ads for one app.

I played this game for a long time now, When ever you advance in the game or close to win a good prize, they make it impossible for you to win without spending real money. For example, if you win a 1 hour life time, no matter if it was a hard level or a normal one, it will not be finished until you spend real money on boosters or that level will consume the majority of the life time you have. Buying my win is not much of fun.

The game is slick, fun and at times challenging and frustrating. You will probably need to spend money on the game at times, I'm over 1,000 levels in and have bought a few bits through the store. In the end of the day, there are no ads and these games aren't free to make, so I don't might spending a couple of quid here and there for the amount of entertainment I've had from the game.

Just another bait game until you reach above stage 100 which forces you into spending money to progress and it expensive. Just isn't worth the time or money, i've been stuck on the same level for quite a while so it's no longer fun, it's frustrating so I'm uninstalling.

Game play I really like playing the game but, the parts where you have to save the king are not even close to what is advertised. I told the makers about this before and they only added a few but none like the things I've seen. Why do you have to lie about the features of the game? The game is already fun! It makes me angry to see the advertisement in between other games that don't lie!!

The game is fun for a while, but then you eventually get to the levels that are impossible to beat without powerups. You can only earn powerups from beating levels or paying real money. The game is obviously designed to get you to spend money. If you are like me, prepare to spend days playing the same level over & over until the RNG allows you to win and move on. King's Nightmare levels are what they show in the ads. You can play to win a tiny bit of gold, or you can skip the entire level.

This was installed by T-Mobile a couple weeks ago (I opted in to sending games or apps I might like) along with 2 other games. This is the one I kept. Royal Match is fun, I'm on level 542. I have spent under $5 total. I also joined a team which helps a lot on getting power-ups and free lives. Lightning Rush is great, because you have unlimited lives for the hour. This game is enjoyable but frustrating 🤣. I played Candy Crush until it became a cash grab, so I'm hoping this game stays as it is.

The ad I saw showed a side-scrolling game where you match gems to move the king across the screen to fight guards. When I downloaded the game, it was yet another Bejeweled style game where you match gems to remove them from the board. Yes, you can build things by removing enough gems, but I wanted a puzzle game where I helped the king defeat guards. So technically the ad doesn't match the actual game play.

This game does what it says. 100%. It says, "No ads" and it keeps its word. (And, though nothing is mentioned about it, you also aren't hounded constantly to make in-app purchases or to upgrade to their "Premium version".) Major props to the developers. In this age of apps that drown you in ads and clearly just want your money, this game is truly a breath of fresh air! I am glad to give them 5 out of 5! I do have to add though, the drowning king shown in the ads is NOT in the game anywhere!!

No annoying ADS! If you join a good team, the lives are almost infinite. Update 07/05/23- caught the game blatantly cheating by adding in last minute players to the lightning rush. Notified Lisa on the support team and SHE LIED TO MY FACE UNTIL SHE REALIZED THAT I HAD SCREEN SHOTS TO PROVE IT! Then she backpedaled with a bs excuse. Advise NOT to spend money on a cheating game.

This is the BEST game! I can't even think of a single complaint. It's fun, challenging, and I love the colors and designs of the levels. The music is cute, too. It's perfect. Also, there are enough moves to beat the hard levels, but you have to try several times or more, and that's what "challenging" actually means. Sometimes you win, sometimes you lose. That's no reason to give a negative review. It is a GREAT game!

Nice game at beginning. No ads, lots of missions. But after level 200, all levels get nearly impossible to pass and game becomes to be very boring and becomes a pay-to-win game. The developer says in his page that game progress cannot be reset - this is not honest. So I installed this game.

Game was OK to begin with. Kept me entertained when ever I was bored however all of a sudden the levels become impossible. There is absolutely no way u can possibly beat the level unless u pay. Its all a big con. Don't bother unless u are prepared to pay for a game thats just something to look at when your bored and let's be honest is just another rip off of candy crush. A game is called a game as your suppose to have a chance to win. This is just nonsense and should be removed

This is by far the BEST, most addictive game I've found. It's fun and yet a challenge. Although it may take time to complete some levels, you eventually will complete them without spending money or using game coins. Customer service has always responded quickly to any issues I've ever had and has resolved them fast. I would recommend joining an active group to also help with extra free lives. I created my own group and have an awesome team that's very active. This game is awesome and I love it!

Unable to move on from levels is very frustrating and very obviously a ploy to get more money out of the user. Funnily enough, adding coins or bonuses still doesn't secure a pass to the level. It is ridiculous as you gain higher levels. I would never recommend this game. If the developers choose to add the ability to watch adds for additional moves, then maybe I would recommend playing, but not until then.

Y'know, if this game was anywhere near as interesting as the ads, it'd still be one star. The ads are fake The king always dies And god forbade you from spending actual money on this 2 hour project There is no way in my 43 years of expirence will I ever download a game from an ad because of this ONE instance. Thank you Royal Match, for showing me that there's soooo much further than rock bottom.

Takes your money! No way to contact customer support! They made changes to the game that took coins from players. For example... they just ended the card set game that has been there forever. I had 7 wildcards that ultimately would hzve unlocked 6000 coins. Instead they took 7 cards and game me 3k in return. I tried to contact customer support and there is no contact option anywhere!

The levels are simple and keep repeating the patterns. How is it possible that you get 1 hr free play and can't clear the level. You use the powers, and still, the level doesn't get cleared. Is this a fair play?? There is no logic or anything, and you guys just want money. Keep it fair for all the players and allow us to apply logic. Even King's puzzle keeps repeating the same again and again . The ad is mi's guiding everyone.

While it's true that there aren't annoying ads the game isn't as advertised. It's just a boring matching game, nothing at all like they claim. In videos you see the king trying to escape a dragon or trying to escape spikes, etc. none of that in this game... very disappointing.

Incredibly frustrating if not prepared to spend. Have reached level 539 without spending but have now been a week on the same level, never getting near to completing it due to not enough moves. I have no problem with charging for boosts, coins etc to allow players to progress more quickly but it shouldn't prevent you from playing the game at all!

Carbon copy of most match games. You will reach a point where no amount of skill will help you win. You will feel pressured by your own need to win( whether is be frustration or the need to accomplish something from the time you spend) to spend money. "Oh it's only 2.99" you say. But compound that with all the following times you spend it....just to win levels in a repetitive and otherwise boring procedural game. You aren't playing the game if you need to pump money in to win impossible levels.

!! PLAY A DIFFERENT BETTER GAME !! One of the worst games ever. Worst of it's kind def. Unless u gotta play this for money then it's pointless. Literally the game will allow to win whenever it feels like it. There's no real strategy and when the game decides to help out it's on its own time or it's too late. Don't be dumb and play this. One star is way too many. Who thought this would be fun at all? I need to know.

I really enjoyed playing this until the hard push to buy packs got to me. That's after already spending 20+ euros to get packs so I could beat levels. Sometimes there's a crazy few amount of moves and your only way through is to use aids that are bought. I wouldn't quite class it as a money grab app, but there's only a thin line of separation.

It can be a fun, addictive game...and as others mention, some levels are nearly impossible to complete in the number of moves given. The amount of gold needed increased from an already high 900 to 1000, so you burn through purchased gold fast...combined with a lower reward amounts detracts from it's attraction as a fun game, to the point of frustrating - so only giving 3 stars right now because of that.

I really enjoy this game but deleted after reaching lvl 639. The super hard lvls are far too difficult to clear unless you want to buy in-app. You can have to replay a lvl several days, 5 lives at a time, before clearing it. I've played Harry Potter Puzzles and Spells for years and you can choose to watch an ad to receive 3 more turns, but not be forced to watch ads if you don't want to.

Downloaded for the save the king stuff, came to the ratings section and am now deleting it, no better than the other fake ads games, either make the game you advertise or don't bother, no other company could get away with pawning off something completely different than advertised. Terrible game, won't be touching any others from The creator.

The game is flat out rigged to make you spend coins. Example, I had three things left to get in one turn, I put together a TNT and a helicopter and it went far enough to the side off the playing field so it would miss the third one. Tell me that wasn't on purpose. And because of things like this I refuse to spend one more dollar on this game.

Love the game but why is the ads for the game so much visually different. The ad I just saw was the player trying to get the blocks away in time to save the king from fire that he's moving upwards too. I'm at level 1195 and have never seen anything like that. I wish I could play that level. It looks really fun. Or is it just the ad making it look more fun. Just wondering?

This game would get a higher rating if it wasn't so difficult once you get over level 150. You're forced to put money into the game to win a level or play the same level for two days before finally beating it. The challenges were fun when I could actually compete in them and the side tasks are fun as well, but now take forever to get even part way through.

Like the game..except with the really hard levels, you run out of lives and then have to quit until the timer expires. This is really frustrating!!! Updated 12/9/24 Now I have been stuck on the same level for almost a week!!!! Not sure why I still play this game

I lost all my progress when I changed device. I saved my progress thru fb. There is even a record of it there. However when I logged in the game using the same fb account, it is not loading my progress anymore. I gave the online customer support team all the info I have but because I didn't join any team they are unable to recover my data :( Even when I gave them the userid # that Fb recorded when I saved it there, they are unable to use it to recover my progress.
