Fun game, but the coin rewards are not enough. The ads are false. Yes, there are no ads, but the Save the King levels are only every 50 levels or so. Otherwise it's just a standard match-3 game. So this is super misleading. And my goodness, the ads for this game are so incredibly annoying! And this game is EXPENSIVE. The boosters and coins are not worth the money and neither is the royal pass. Also there should be an extra moves reward of sorts.

To be honest, the nice thing about this game is there are no ads. But furthermore it's the usual recipe: you sail through the first 150 or so levels with no problem and then after that, of course the levels become almost impossible to win, where you would have won if you had just had one more move or the right colour chips needed to reach the goal. Also hate that the light balls blast when another power up is blown up next to it. The game therefore gets boring pretty soon. Uninstalling, sorry.

Boring. Predatory. Downloaded it because I absolutely loath the annoying ads, and you have to download to review. Tried it so I could honestly say that it's boring and predatory. Avoid this game at all costs and if given the option, report the ads for being misleading, when they pop up. Because they are.

Starts out with fun and challenging yet possible to complete levels and immediately takes a hard turn after 50 or so levels. It's impossible to play now without equipping all power ups available to you, and levels expect you to destroy 100+ items with just 15 moves. Really disappointed.

I actually play this game a lot but am thinking of playing a new one instead. The biggest issue is when you work hard and win you get perks , but if you lose at all you lose the perks you work for! That's just wrong. It's like missing a day at work and them taking the entire weeks salary. This ruins the game. Please fix it .

This game is fun. But why do developers think its a good idea to make games that cannot be played without buying boosters and whatever? I know it's a product sold by a business, but making the "easy" unpassable only makes me want to uninstall. I'd rather watch adds than loose a level 25 times.

Fantastic game so far, been playing for awhile and see myself easily getting hooked. Games with "optional" (compulsory to even being able to clear a level) bonuses are a massive date hog when I'm out and about on 5G. …and ain't nobody (frankly) got time for all that. We're busy—dream's team is too,—but this is the most engaging first :15 I've had in a matcher. Newb tip, combo alchemy is a blast, so to say. My mobile plan and I say "thank you." I *do* got time for all this.

I kept seeing ads promising no wifi needed, no ads....Sound too good to be true? IT IS. I quit for months then logged back in (at level 309) - Played ONE level then was forced to enable WiFi to continue! Move up to the tougher levels and you need WiFi to watch ads or pay up - I don't mind videos to earn boosters but don't lie about it in your ads!

Game is favourable only when you make in app purchases. You can play without buying stuff for only certain number of rounds after which it becomes impossible to clear the rounds.. i spent a lot initially, but then its becoming irritating to continue as game solely depends only on ur interest to make purchases.

I swear I had already written a five star review, so I'm unsure why it got deleted. Anyway, I love this game. My interest has waned a little as tasks have gotten more difficult, but the game gives you the means to complete the tasks. I appreciate that and will play from time to time. I've been playing for months to give you an idea. Edit: I wanted to add that my favorite levels are the ones with lots of combos, even when they're difficult to complete.

Fantastic graphics and great, unique games. Problem is that it's nearly impossible to play for free. You can't make any progress. Even if you make a purchase, they are used up quickly just trying finish a game. It's a shame. Loved it. Can't play any longer. Greedy app.

So much fun! I love these kind of games and this has become my fav. There is absolutely zero reason to need to pay to play! Those who complained burnt out there boosts in easy low lvl and dont know how to save coins. They never figured out how to strategize in these games. This game keeps you engaged in so many ways and makes it easy to get bonus items and coins. I love building the castle.I do wish there were more king's matches tho. When you get to the high levels they are few and far between.

Fake ads of "saving" the king. It's more of a "build your castle" type of game. And of course, like all of these puzzle match games as you get on in level, power ups suddenly become a requirement or some real God level RNG. It's just another cash grab game so don't bother

😡💲PAY TO PLAY 💲😡 The levels when you first play are so easy with lots of power-ups Then, as the game continues on, it's impossible to win a level without paying for coins or power-ups. To pass a level, I was going to pay money, but then I came to realization it's NOT WORTH IT!

At the beginning of the 1st 100 levels you find the game so enjoyable but after that the game turn to be as other games PAY TO WIN because you are going to lose from the difficulty of the levels with a small amount of moves that you may lose 5 moves from the beginning of the round just to make more space to play free in the end my advise DO NOT INSTALL THIS GAME, IT'S A SCAM.

The game does not even match with the ad. It only happen after clearing around 20 stage of the match 3 game than let u have fun saving the king for 1 rd. I love this game!!! NO ADS!!! 🤗 100 % fun!!!! I recommend the whole Crew download this game join the same team play! Only downside is you can't join the same team if you're on different devices it seems 🤔🧐. I have not figured this out yet. But when I do I might start a new team this game is fun!!!!

Level 398 and not one dollar spent to play this game. It can be done. Sometimes it's a waste to spend coins you earn in game. I once spent 3 days on an impossible level, then one round every thing fell into place. Join an active team and you'll earn extra things occasionally. This game allows you to waste time, if you pay to skip that time why bother playing?

It's a great game, but it's not. I'm performing the objective, but my moves aren't working. I'm wasting moves when I should be breaking potion bottles or dishes. Seems like the game is purposefully not working so I lose. I'm not spending money. Sorry. This game is disappointing.

When theres a super hard or hard Level and you can't beat it, you have to try over and and over again, until they give you 30 tries in exchange for 900 coins. It consumes your time and energy. Sometimes i just keep trying until they make it easy for me without taking away 900 coins.

I paid $10 for the pass. I had a problem with team members not seeing my help requests. I contacted support with my boyfriend to figure out a way to fix this. They did not find a solution so I'm basically SOL. The only reason I bought the pass was to get more purple balls for the dragon nest game because a team member joined and failed to contribute at all, so I'm trying to complete it on my own to not let down everyone else. Unfortunately, this game company doesn't care. Sorry team!

I've been playing this game for some time now, and I really do enjoy it. The developers really do a good job with creating new and challenging levels. However, I just wish that when you have the opportunity to earn 2x rewards that it would also include the amount of coins you receive for every level you complete!! Otherwise, it's a great game and a good way to pass some time.

A truly free game. I haven't spent a dime and I consistently top out competitions. With a little self discipline, strategy, and dedicated playing time, I'm on a level in the 7000's. Nice quick play. My only complaint is that sometimes the animations take more time than I like. not typically a big deal, but if you accumulate 1000 stars, it'll take considerable time to get through them.

I'm tired of this game. I'm stuck on 'Hard Level' 372 and it's beginning to irritate me. The only reason it's hard is because you don't get enough moves to succeed. The powerups fall into areas away from where they have no impact whatsoever, and some of the objects have to be hit 3 or 4 times to remove them. 27 moves is simply not enough. The only way you eventually win is when the cunning algorithm senses you're not going to spend any money and therefore it lets you win, finally. Had enough.

Therapeutic Game... The only game I've played the most in my life... I love it so much.. I also love that my progress is saved... I recently reset my phone and I was worried about starting from level 1,only to find the "Save progress" button.... I'm currently over level 720.. I love love love everything about this game. It's for keeps and a must have.

You have to make enough hits, with inadequate amount of ammunition! You have to play a level x amount of times to complete it, its so frustrating at times. The developers should revamp the game, based on users feedback! Imagine, you pay for the game, then it literally robs you bare face and the developers think, that the game is bug free!

If the whole game was kings nightmares that would be awesome. It is as advertised, but only every one in a while do you get them. The music is fine at first but after a while the music is just annoying. I also like how you can play through the entire game for free and nonstop. And only pay for stuff if you want to.

5 stars just cause it has no ads in game. It's a good game, basic match the colors game. I'm on level 2700 and I've only lost about 20 levels, 1 just cause I wanted to see what happens if you lose a level. I don't find it challenging and I've never spent a cent on this game. Not much like what's described on the ads but it's pretty entertaining. Every blue moon you play a save the king level but they're few and far between, like every 50 or 100 levels or so.

I give only three stars because even though I enjoy the game it is almost impossible to pass so e levels without spending money. And when you clear a level you get the same amount of rewards. True to their word no ads .The games you see in ad are mini games .It's a match three and beyond puzzle .Animations are cute. Needs internet every few 100 levels to download next level.Unparalleled. The best. Download it NOW.

IT'S ABOUT TIME!!!!!! Finally, a game with NO ads!!!! And game play IS as shown when you watch ads while you play other games. (It's actually the minigame, but is still in line with the match-3 theme.) The graphics are cute, music is catchy, solve engaging puzzles to decorate different areas, and I have been playing for 3 hours, as rewards are generous. My only suggestion is to be able to "undo" a move for coins.

I downloaded this game for credits in MistPlay, and I fell in love. This game is easy to play, making it perfect for all ages. The animations are nice and smooth, and the use of powerups is fun and satisfying. There are no ads. The ads for the game are a bit off - it's a match-3 style game, not a block game, but the game is more enjoyable than I thought it would be.

I really enjoy this game, so much so that I've made it over 2000 levels and am still playing. No ads, not overly greedy and loads of fun. I deducted one star due to the fact in game it states you get 25 tokens for duplicate cards and although I've gotten several duplicate gold cards it only gives 5 tokens no matter the card and it takes absolutely forever to obtain a wild card. Other than that, outstanding job.

Loved it, then it got to the point that you can't play without paying. I beat over 7000 levels and enjoyed it, around levels 7260, every single level was so difficult I was stuck on it for days. It became boring, frustrating and repetitive. It's ok to have a hard level, there were plenty. But to put super difficult levels one after the other with no respite and seriously no way to win unless you buy extra levels or power ups just made me quit the game. I'm sad and I hope they fix it.

Like so many others have said, the problem with this game is it is absolutely impossible to keep advancing without spending money. You would think after so many complaints, they would change it a little. They're just after your money and know they can get new players. Wish I had half of what I spent back. Never again!

I don't know what going on? But I noticed the price raise that is way out of control. Not enough options like they use to have. $6.99, $19.99 deal are gone They been promoting that $44.99 deal. Already spending $9.99 for the season pass then another $6.99 or more for the week. But when I start seeing $44.99 as a start when I'm use to spend $6.99 or $9.99.

I didn't download this game for a long time. I figured the ads were just teasers like a lot of others and the game would be totally different. I finally downloaded it a couple of days ago and I love it! I don't understand the complaints about the levels getting to hard to solve. You are given ample opportunity to gather bombs etc. And a good game does get progressively more difficult. You don't have to spend money to play, no ads, no wifi necessary. 5 stars from me.

Rigged so you have to spend real money. At first it was fun to play but as you get higher levels you can't beat them without spending money on power up items. This is intentional and the developers know it. But those with addictive personalities will wind up spending too much money trying to beat just one level.

SMALL HINT AT END: I'd given the game 5*s. Then 4* cause they took away the super spinner without notice to force a download of the update. Now? 3*s. This games sucks. It's just a different kind of Candy Crush. The advertisements made it seem cool but it is nothing like the advertisements that you are forced to watch while playing other games. It's as good as any other swipe match game. I gave it a 2 star because I'm tired of games advertising something they don't actually do. New edit, I've given the star back, I've actully found where you can save the king lol, since that was my beef to begin with. Great game - No Ad's ever - and you can play without pay - I've done it. I enjoy this game, pass' the time when needed. Collect your points and keep on going. Thanks to the creator, very enjoyable, and did I say No ads!

The thing about puzzle games of this sort is that at a certain point in the game, you will be enticed or forced to purchase to carry on. I enjoy the game, I also enjoy competing w/other players! I only download the app for 1 reason, to give it a honest review. It's NOTHING like the ads. It's like any other match game, easy, boring and repetitive. This game is nothing but another Fishdom. Another match 3 game, that does not allow enuff moves, to clear a board & move on. As others have said, it's fun at first, then becomes impossible to beat the levels. It's fun to play. I like the game though challenging to win at times. However, 900 coins is a lot to give for five more games. I had two games left and bought five more which should have been seven but only five registered. I have also bought the Royal package and other packages. Since it is pay to play involved and no real gifts, I give it a three.

Just wish there was a way to save life time as often, I don't want to play for 2 or 3 hrs in one go. I love this game but it is WAY too expensive!! I've played other games for years and have not spent as much as I have with this game. I had been playing this game over a year. Made it over level 4000. Then it started crashing, taking up all the memory on my device and would not loaf after the last update. However, it turns out that when I re installed this game It was actual just this game. It still freezes, crashes or just won't start. Great update! Now I will be deleting your game

It's a money grabber. If you manage to max out and complete all levels, the levels become so ridiculously difficult that you pretty much have to spend money in the game to move on. All in all, it's a fun, addictive game. The game runs smoothly and is brilliantly designed but, the developers are cashing in on this one for sure. Play at your own risk, and if you start feeling like you have to spend money to win, uninstall immediately or you will go broke.

If you want to play the same level over and over and over...this is the game for you! Update: I decided to delete the game. It would be fun to play the game and move through the levels, but you really have to play some levels for days, and I finally got sick of it. If you ask for help, it will involve giving more money. Some of the people that help out on levels with free play time, but some refuse to help and only want money. Sad

My complaint about this game isn't the usual - you get enough coins per level to keep it interesting. I got to level 2000 before packing it in. Why? The game is buggy, that's why. There's a specific match target to get specific power-ups, but when I meet them, I either don't get the proper power-up, or sometimes none at all. But the worst offender was one stage - I finished the stage on the final move, but it said that I failed. Nope. It's broken, and I won't play a broken game.

Overall a good game, but the later levels are too difficult. Yes, you can beat levels without boosters or coins but that requires a lot of luck, and you will end up with 0 lives and nothing to help fast. I suggest making boosters easier to get early on or maybe have one free booster for watching an ad. Optional, but helpful. Plus ad money is easy money but it's not in the player's face. It's a win/win.

This game is so much fun. One of the best 3 solve puzzles games. However, you only have a finite of time to play for free. The problem, is that I will receive 30 min or more to play with free lives but I'm unavailable. When I am available, I don't have enough lives. If you could charge something reasonable like $4.99 to play whenever, I will happily sign up. I want to play but with the current pricing structure it doesn't make any sense.

I'm really enjoying this game. I like that there isn't a scoring system, just goals to achieve and there is a lot of opportunity to get free lives. My only complaints are that some of the levels are clearly reused with tiny changes and the advertised levels aren't really in the game. I'm passed 1000 and I've maybe had 2 or 3 King related levels. Not sure how far you have to go to get the ones in the adds, but it seems like a lot.

Great game, but definitely set up to make you spend money. Totally rigged on every level. Almost every game ends with only one move left to make for the win, but it will cost you 900 coins to continue. And when you do pay and have a lot of coins in the bank, you won't win again until they are all gone. Then, just like magic, you win. Total rip off if you pay for anything. You are better off not paying and gettin the same redults.

I gave this game my very best, but alas it just wasn't satisfactory. It possesses some redeeming qualities like having no ads, but that isn't enough to save it from what is essentially 50% based on luck. And when I become stuck simply because the game decides to not give me what I need to progress without becoming a pay to win, it no longer becomes fun. I'm sorry, but i cannot recommend this game to anyone else. 😔

This game is no better than Candy Crush. It advertises saving the King but I'm on level 34 and all its been is clearing the level to furnish the Castle. If the adverts aren't lies, I would suspect it takes you to level 100 before you get to the levels of saving the King as advertised. I think it's all a lie. The only good thing is there isn't any ads at all, so not like ur interrupted every 2 mins with ads. Still a fun game but not as advertised.

I've played many Match 3 games, but none compare to this. Unlike most its centered around powerups and items but in such a way that you almost will always have what you need, making it much more fun than a game like Candy Crush. The constant stream of rewards helps keep you going just enough to beat the level. Almost every new gimmick feels unique no matter how similar it actually is. Even if/when the gimmick isn't the greatest, the theming is on point.

it is a cute fun game so far! I will rate more later. The royal match ad needs to be shortened instead of thinking you are done and 2 more ads of it! I understand ads make you money, but they are becoming a lot longer and more. I love the game and money still. I still give it a five star...it's fun!!!

1% player strategy, 99% game controlled fate, you cannot win unless the game allows you to win... You will need power ups to finish the most difficult levels, if the game does not give you the power ups you will need to buy them (real world cash, not game cash). I got stuck for two days at the level 219, because I'm not willing to spend money I rather delete the game...

Every single ad is a 100% false. There is not 1 single level that represents the levels shown in ads. I'm on level 1931 and have never had one any way. It's a decent game and there's no ads. That's why I like it. Wish the levels were more interesting as advertised. I'd give it 5 stars if the ads were accurate.

DON'T believe the ads! The ads portray the game to where you have to clear the pieces (sort of like candy crush) to save the king, and that's it. NOPE. Just a few mini games, then you have to do tasks (like homescapes) that I have no interest in doing. Fastest game uninstall ever!

So, this is a fun game until you hit level 1000. You are better off playing Castle Crush. Then, you basically have to pay for upgrades & use the extras/upgrades to even win a game. I have been stuck on the same level now for a week. There is also times where I open up a treasure chest that will show I'm getting large amounts of premium currency & then not get that amount. Overall, it is a fun game. But, they make you pay for it.

I got about 15 hours in the game now. In terms of gameplay, i give this a 4/5 stars. Simple, fun and addictive. I give it a 5/5 tho because there are NO ADS! Almost all mobile games have ads every 2 minutes and its a huge turnoff. I've pretty much uninstalled every game that has ads cus it ruins the fun and flow of the game. I appreciate the game devs for focusing on the players having fun rather than being greedy and selling out for advertiser's money.

4th time trying to post a review on this game without it being deleted. The game is definitely pay for luck/pay to play. It pits you up against other people (supposedly), and puts a fake sense of urgency to the game so that you'll pay money to beat more levels than them. The levels themselves are "COMPLETELY" beatable with enough tries and a perfect round, but it's always easier to use power-ups to beat these impossible levels, am I right?

I like to play this game alot but....I have spent far too much money on this site than any other site EVER and the algorithm knows this and it plays to spend data it atrocious!!! You need to be fair in the rewards to the amount of coins collected and the gold spent. It basically doesn't let you progress unless you spend.

This game is really fun, it might not be exactly what the ads say but it is a lot of fun, it doesn't force you to use power ups it gives you free ones that show you how to use it then keep all the ones that it gave you it us amazing after clearing, or building, an area it gives you power ups and gold so it is useful to do so so you can continue to play the fun game that it is. A bonus round comes up that is like the ads that you play and they are a lot of fun. And there are no repetitive ads. :)

This game is very misleading in my view. Not really free unless you want to stay stuck at a level for days on end. Very difficult to get ahead to higher levels without paying. Don't waste your time. Deleted it once I realized the farther you get, the more often you pay. A big thumbs down! 👎

This is a fun and quick moving game. I think the graphics are great. Right now I'm dealing with a bit of a glitch. One of the main reward icons isn't showing and or giving my rewards. One of the main parts of the game is to win pieces to add to a room at the castle. But another glitch for me now is I cannot go back and review all the rooms I have decorated while playing the game. I do still like playing it a lot.

This game is what everyone says- fun but costly. It is impossible to win without money after a certain level is reached. I still played (and paid) until multiple times a week, I was having technical issues- game closing randomly, levels freezing & starting over for no reason causing me to waste power ups & money over game errors repeatedly. The final straw was reaching out to tech support over my issues and being ignored and brushed off. Avoid at all costs, it isn't worth the frustration.

It's ok, a little unfriendly on the penalties, which is how they make money. It is definitely not relaxing, as the ads claim, and this genre is so overdone that it is surprising that people still play it. Once you've played one, you've played them all. The trick is not to alienate your customer base, as this one starts to do early. One star removed for this Thanks for letting me try. Tell the old man in the ad to stop lying to ppl. I hate ads that don't represent the game, another star removed.

What a con. Looks great in the adverts, fun challenges and all but how dull, you have play loads of boring levels, which are just random clicks to get rid of stuff and then occasionally a decent level appears, like you're expecting. Misleading adverts and a load of rubbish. Heaven knows how it gets 4 stars!

It's an algorithm disguised as a game. There's no strategy or skill once you get to the higher levels. You either pay to win or you go through the designated amount of "fails" until it lets you pass. Also the advertising is very deceptive. Those are "Kings Nightmare" levels in the ads and they aren't nearly as elaborate or animated in game as advertised. Feels like Electronic Arts should have made this app. Scam.

Don't waste your time and MONEY, cause that's exactly what it will take to beat the higher levels. It's not a game. It's algorithm is strategically set up to let you win or make you lose. Most games are obviously created to make money and that's OK. But to create a game and make it to where you have to spend money to beat it, takes the fun out of it to say the least. Worst game ever made. It's developed to make money period!

False advertisement! I hate that 😡 Not what you expect, a boring puzzle game. Nothing like what is shown in the advertisement of saving the king with playing puzzles. That is more exciting than building a castle by buying stars feom plating a puzzle. The same thing like the other games, boring. Stop showing this if it isn't the game.

Interesting game. But the higher you go up in levels, it gets more difficult. In most of the levels it's hard to finish within the limited moves and if you want extra moves, for the first 5 extra moves it's 900, the next 5 it's 1900... It goes on........ I played upto level 297 and I'm uninstalling as I don't like a game with limited moves to play

I used to love this game and have been playing for 2 years. Even though some levels could take a while to get through, it was still playable. Just recently though they introduced a thing where every time you fail they offer you more and more moves if you pay, whereas it used to just stay at 5 extra moves. That's fair enough but each level is now impossible to pass without paying for extra moves. You can't even get close to passing. It's taken all the fun out of it and I feel like a cash cow

If you love Pay to win games this is the game for you! The game looks great with lovely animations. But at the heart of the game is incredibly difficult levels that you need to throw money at in order to win. Thankfully I realized that before I could waste money on this game. I am giving it one star for the visuals. Reached level 241 before uninstalling

Generally I like this game. However the money hungry developers recently decided that the Kings Nightmare feature should be changed. It used to show up every day, if you beat the level in the time allotted you would get 15 min of free play plus 15 min of a booster. This really helped if you were stuck on a hard or super hard level. Now the devs made Kings Nightmare random and you get a whopping 50 coins for beating it. Pretty soon, you will have to pay them for the privilege of playing.

I HATE this gamete! The ads show the fun levels, but those are far and few between. some levels are very hard to pass and the game demands you purchase things to pass the level. Not a free game! HATE this stupid game and the CONSTANT Ads! If it was a fun game they wouldn't cram it down everyone's throat, Beware you WILL be forced to pay!

UPDATE: I went ahead and uninstalled it. I reached out to both games' customer service. They give you the run around. For whatever reason, it's not registering as being installed on my device. Therefore, I can't complete the task. I will uninstall if it doesn't register soon.

Once you get into it, it seems fun but the more you play the "harder" the levels get meaning they want you to spend money on a match-3 game for powerups. Ads are also misleading and annoying where they show a king in danger or is about to get hurt or die. There is no dying king or any time trial like shown in the ads, just a match 3 game like any other that wants you to spend the more you play

Royal match is very disappointing because the commercials is not the same as the gameplay and I don't think showing failed ads is smart(my opinion) I downloaded and deleted the game. I don't think it's smart to show a section of the game that a user could pass but decide not to just to show consequences of a loss and not a win when it doesn't even equal the real gameplay. False advertising has many definitions and this one shows alot. It would be different if it was difficult or continuous.

Very fun addictive game. Some will not receive some of the game functions. I noticed my boyfriend gets the mission pursuit, and I've never got it! I'm the one who told him to download the game. So just be prepared because some might not get all the fun extra stuff that comes with the game. I'm so upset with this game now. I've been playing for years and have spent a lot. Do better royal match, and everyone should get it, not just some.

This game and one of its similarly named cousins somehow managed to automatically install on both of my android devices, circumventing all confirmations, checks, etc. I've no idea how, given the first time I've visited the store page is to write this statement. Clearly something very dodgy about the way the developers operate. Couldn't care less about the game itself, I uninstalled it immediately, as I would any other application that acts like malware.

While this game has no ads, the app's hyperagressive ad campaign is borderline fraud and harassment. The ad service this app uses to advertise is just short of malware, and the game, while similar to the ads, does not contain enough similarities to the ads to make me want to play. I literally only installed this app to let you know that this app has made me angrier than any other from the harassing ads alone. I will not play and will uninstall after posting this.

Was fun, was going to give 5 stars, not only do they give you power ups, you keep earning them through the game. But you give way too little coins when it cost so much to keep going. I have ended a stage with 20 moves & earned less than 75 coins. other match 3 games have given thousands. I am willing to pay here & there but not when I keep running out. Not going to pay to keep playing. Unless you fix the coin shortage, am uninstalling. And you cannot win every level without help!

it's OK, passes the time when waiting for the bus, or during ad breaks on TV. basically a cheaper looking rehash of garden scapes etc, lacking the same quality in terms of graphical content, music BUT...so far no attempts to make me spend real cash, no intrusive ads, just plays freely, and this is to be commended.

This game is a very good example of its type - great animations, decent tournaments (although no narrative). Gripes: 1) By the time it starts taking 100 levels to finish an area, all levels are "Super Hard" difficulty and the difficulty labels don't mean much. This demoralizes players. 2) King's Nightmare levels are clearly an afterthought put in to make the ads less of a bait-and-switch. I recommend making the final level before any end-of-area bonus level a "King's Nightmare" boss puzzle.

Skill is irrelevant in this game. The outcome of each level is predetermined. And there is absolute inconsistencies when a level is labeled 'hard' or 'super hard'. The game allows me to consistently win in 3 or 4 attempts when it's labeled a 'super hard' level, yet will eat up all 20 of my lives on a level that is supposed to be normal difficulty? Why bother labeling then? It's all about luck, not skill. Think of it as a slot machine... play long enough, and you'll eventually hit. 😕

I'm not happy with the last update. I was at level 9000, now I don't get the free coin level at every 100. I'm forced to play the group game for days. I've accumulated almost 600 levels, no coin levels and it doesn't count as how many levels I've gone up. I would have reached 10,000 but doesn't count. Not fair I hate that I'm forced to update every time these new level games are finished. I want my normal every 100 level rewards!!! I'm about ready to delete this app.

Ok up until they just want money from you. Games are fun at the beginning but then they make them impossible to pass unless you buy extra moves at £3 or more. As it is very addictive I can imagine a few people will fall for this. Also the advertised gameplay is very false. I will be uninstalling very soon.

It's good, but not many mini games, like the ads show. I only played 2 or 3, and I'm on level 616. I wish there were more. Those were fun. But the game itself is decent. I like no ads, but waiting 30 mns for a life can be tough. But they like to give boosts and things, so it's kind of a wash there. I docked it the one star for the lack of mini games. I like the levels where you earn coins, but I'd rather save the king now and then.

I am so sick of getting caught up in the ad loops!! Have to continually get out, restart, and HOPE I can get back to the puzzle. Often this has to be repeated several times! To top it off, most of the time, the game being advertised is one I Already have downloaded! Takes all the peaceful enjoyment out of doing the puzzles. Bummer. FIX THIS and I'd give it 5 stars

At first, the game seems like it's just about saving the king, but there's so much more to it. You almost forget that was how it was advertised. There are no ads, and every few days, you get new challenges and rewards to help with the harder levels. It’s such a fun game, and I can’t go a day without playing it. I highly recommend it!

UPDATE 2 years later and still none of the things i suggested. Oh, well!! It was 3 stars, now 1 I wish there were ways to earn coins, like watching video ads. And it cost so many coins, 900 coins to get additional help?!?!! I've been hoping an update would be one where y'all would lower the cost, then I will spend money to continue. It would be worth it then.

Scam most of the time. I won lightning round challenge, I had 13k points it kept saying connection error. So I thought ok when it reloads it will send the data but nope I got credit for all the levels and everything but not for the challenge. I have spent close to probably 500 Dollars in this game and it always charges me twice or three times and then I spend money to win these things and this happens, I'm about done with this app and others created by the same. Stay away it's just a money trap.

it's ok I just think you should earn more than one star when you complete a level, one star is not enough it takes forever to build the stars up & takes longer to be able to build & if you run out of moves it takes 900 coins to continue the 1st time that's ridiculous, it should not take that much to continue & then it continues to go up each time, may be deleting

It just a puzzle game. I haven't brought anything and I will not lol. But they REALLY need to work on this game and fix problems. Love this game and the sound sound effects it makes me tap on some of the icons. But I gave it 2 stars because I see a little cheating with the game itself. When you should get a bomb or some of the other things they disappear. Very annoyed. It's like the game blocks you from winning. If it keeps happening will delete and let team know why. Will also post it on FB.

I haven't found a Match-3 game I love this much since the early days of Candy Crush! I see reviews saying the difficulty of the levels becomes too steep, but I love the challenge. It's so rewarding when I finally beat a tough one! Plus, you gain so many boosters and coins along the way, that it's easy to add an extra boost or extra moves when you need it. No money is necessary to beat any level, if you're persistent and try new approaches. Definitely a 5-star game!

Uninstalled "The levels get too hard you have to spend money"Mystic somebody said. No one's making you spend money. I need a long break from this. Good luck to all

It is a really nice game in the beginning really addictive until it reaches level 155 and up where there are super hard levels in which you use all your boosts in order to clear them until a point where it needs you to purchase items in order to win the game . It is unfair that nowadays to win a game you need to buy your way through it I miss the old days where playing games in hard levels would give you even small probabilities of winning but what's the point of making it hard in order to pay

I gave this game 3 stars because I do enjoy the game. But you hardly ever save the king! That is what was supposed to make this game unique. I am going to keep it for little bit longer but I think I'm gonna be done with this game soon. Good for someone who's looking for a classic drop the block game. All of the adds say there are absolutely no ads! It's true. I think I really would like this game IF you could save the king more often. Like every other level or so. The graphics are also smooth.

Very difficult to increase levels unless you pay to play. The moves are very limited and although you can make more moves, the game ends. I am at level 359 and can't complete this level with buying additional items. I understand it being hard but not impossible. Getting ready to find a new game. After you expend your 5 lives, game makes you wait about 30 minutes to get just 1 single life. It is getting boring.

Great game. But costs tons of money past level 300. I'm at level 1000 and have spent so much up to this point. It's now so impossible! Time to delete. Update, lowered the rating because now it cheats. You swipe one direction and the object goes to the opposite direction and you lose the game. It's happened more than a hundred times, so it's not a one off.

This game is fun and addicting when you're actually winning. However, the game is rigged and will try to get you to pay cash for things. It's so addicting that I actually paid on numerous occasions. It allows you an awesome fun winning streak then it takes it away. It's so obvious when that happens; NOTHING will be in your favor. You'll lose miserably over and over until FINALLY it'll allow you to start running again.

I feel cheated. I downloaded this game because it looked awesome and different on the adverts. I thought you had to save the king by solving puzzles. If you made the game where every level was saving the king, you would have the best pizzle game ever.

It's fun to play. I like all the different levels, but I wish they all weren't so hard to complete. There are one or two easy ones, but not that many as you progress. My major complaint is that it takes 900 coins to get more moves. Considering you don't get many to begin with, it's a pretty high number. It basically almost forces you to pay money to play. I don't like that.

It's a fun game,but be prepared to be stuck in every other level once you pay for anything. if you join an active tram that wins team challenges, it helps get coins to bypass levels you are stuck on. also the game isn't like its advertised. you are not saving the king. its making matches and winning team challenges mostly.

Great game, very smooth interface and I like the puzzles and how they change to get harder over time. Recent addition of the side games look great but I can't really play them much cause it takes me way too long to get past the higher levels to earn the items required. Feel like it needs more ways to earn coins or reduce the play on amount to keep players engaged past a certain point without paying loads

I've been playing for a LONG time. I have a great team, I'm on level 3444. I can't agree with a lot of the negative reviews regarding this game. I've purchased many coins, I purchase the Royal Pass every single month. I've only had an issue with a purchase 1 time & customer service was beyond helpful & very giving. My 3 stars is due to the fact that they raised the extra moves cost from 900 coins, to 1900 coins. This isn't okay in my opinion. Give us options instead. Not cool.

I enjoy the game a lot, but whenever I see a level with envelopes needed to finish, I lose the will to live as there are rarely enough moves to finish the level. I agree with others that the difficulty rises quite quickly after the first 50 odd levels, but I kinda expected that in a game with no ads. Overall, it's a nice game, but I think some levels need more moves to be able to finish them.

This game is a lot of fun! It's such a great time killer! Yes, it's a matching game, but it's not the same as all others. There's quite a bit more to it! There are mini events/side games and different contests between other players's daily! Also, you're building yourself a castle, too! So that's what makes it different! Can you spend money? Yes! But do you need or have to? NO!! It's not pay to win or pay to play! I definitely would recommend Royal Match to my friends or anyone else! I love it!

Good game. Helps keep u occupied. Only issue is that it is a pay to win game. The number of times I have only 1 item left to clear with less than 900 coins is insane. The levels are too difficult to win. You either pay money or you have to use the boosters to win. Even then it is iffy if you win. I didn't mind spending money on this game as l really enjoyed it, but when you changed it from 900 coins to 1500 coins, it's a lot more expensive. Won't be playing any more and deleting the game. I enjoy playing the game as a way to relax, but sometimes I end up getting frustrated as pieces line up make few to no matches and I run out of turns before even ½way through a puzzle... Royal Match has improved on it's game ideas and play. Originally, I was disappointed with the advertisements that portrayed the game having you save the king from peril. Ad misrepresents gameplay. Every eight levels or so the king has a nightmare where you basically have to reach some goal in some time limit. I downloaded this game specifically to write this review, once I'm done I'm immediately deleting this trashy game. I play other games, and this game always features as in-game ad in those games. Love the game, HATE the "areas". I am now stuck on level 8000 until I complete all "areas" and it takes forever!! There should be a skip button, to just finish the area and not have to wait for every single item to get placed and then wait to see it all together. I just want to play the game!

Game is rigged. The developers run algorithms to give you difficult levels when you enter the league play. They only develop 100 levels every so often and it doesn't take long to complete 100 levels. This is great time passer. The levels are fun and very challenging. Some... are TOO challenging though. Especially as you get higher up. You will have to use a lot of help items or coins to beat them. But, those things can be earned in game so it's not a pay to play/win type game.

Impossible to advance without paying, extremely frustrating!!! In the beginning I really enjoyed this game. But around level 200 it gets impossible to win without paying for extras. Really frustrating. And you don't get alot from what you pay. In my opinion the people who are going to put money into these games will do so regardless. The people who can't invest alot of money will get frustrated, delete the app, and leave bad reviews like me. The company would do better to make levels beatable.

I thank you that the game has so many great features but the most annoying thing to me is is constantly having to save King you don't get to really enjoy the game. It would make you start to wonder if he was a king for real, it would make you wonder where are all of his bodyguards are thay everyone can constantly get him, I mean I don't mind other mini games in the game but constantly rescuing him gets boring..

Been playing a couple of years and almost at level 5000 for the second time. Deleted the game once before to start again. It is extremely expensive in order to advance in levels or win any tournaments. $25 for 25,000 coins at a 50% discount and only last for about 1 to 2 hours of play time. Almost every level costs 900 to 1200 coins to add 5 moves unless you give up the power play and spend hours or days to win 1 level.

The game is good but the moves are very limited. And of course there is luck to get the power types. But still the moves are very limited. Not good for kids. I dont really recommend the game. Grandscape is better though. And cant choose the design of the place. Not really that amazed.

Probably better than most, but also gets incredibly frustrating once you move through the game cause it gets more and more based around just getting lucky (or paying) in order to progress. If there was a high score mode I'd kind of recommend it but there isn't, just a ton of different monetization methods and incentives to spend money

Rigged. Game can be very fun, but you can tell that it's rigged to try to get you to spend money. The game will give you a "bad hand" after you've gotten a nice power up and are down on coins, so you lose it if you don't pay. Then, if you've been struggling with a level, it will randomly give you a really easy hand so you don't just quit the game. I don't like feeling manipulated.

Love the game. An issue I have though is that I have played alot of levels and was just able to get passed level 2324 after several plays, which I would consider extremely hard but it was not mark as a hard level. The next level 2325 is mark hard and I'm sure I'll get through it with less difficulty.

NEW: I have to say this game has improved so much. Different games, within game. My dislike is the amount you pay to play. Yes free if you want to play same level over & over. Keep providing worthwhile update OLD Why is the game not providing the 150 free points with purchase of 5 @ 2.99? I have purchased at least 10 coin packs, and counter stays at one!! 11-22-21 I did your uodate, it is working. However i lost game play time, and postive lost items. ........old Game won't open after updates.

Can't say it's bad, nor good. When the level is easy to play, it's fun. But to play a consecutive hard levels, like 5 consecutive ones, it's really wasting my time, power ups, and coins just to lose and lose again, and it prevents me to get bonuses. made the player feel needs to spend money to win. Nah, I'll just leave for days and come back later when the game decides to make the level easy to me. But I'm having fun playing this game.

No way to get friends for extra lives. Fun game. No ads. But some levels are difficult to do without extra boosters. I find the game glitches, making a move to create a booster or connect two, it doesn't happen. Good time to curse! No need to spend money. But if you're in a rush to level up then by all means spend your cash. You can get stuck on a hard level but walk away and go do something else. I have gotten to level 800 without spending one cent. I have more time than money.

Misleading adverts but still fun. The adverts I saw for this game depict the king trying to escape from scenarios, all the while managing to escape due to the user solving the puzzles. This isn't the case during the game. Most of the levels don't involve any animation with the king, and the rare ones that do (the kings nightmare levels) have the animation on the top and the game below, not interacting together like the adverts show. Not a fair depiction on the adverts!!!

This game starts off fun and enjoyable but quickly becomes difficult & without purchasing items it's impossible to defeat the games. Those items are not cheap either. Eventually you need them for almost every round. What draws you to the game is saving the king with various puzzles... That only happens maybe once in every 30 games or so. It's a good thing the app is free because you spend a lot of money to be able to continue playing.

I found this game EXTREMELY ANNOYING!! as soon you do not make a move in FOUR SECONDS it starts making pieces flash! As if it is saying "here is a match because you are too stupid to see it". I HATE that. I want to actually LOOK at the board and study it, to PLAN moves to build up a bigger move so pieces fall into place! The flashing in 4 seconds is insane! Plus the castle RUINED the view of the lake!! Also hate timed levels. I will delete games with flashing pieces! Flashing = annoying!!

The game itself was fun and sometimes challenging, which was perfect for a bit. Then once you've built up $1-3k in winnings to buy boosters, they hit you with "super hard" levels that are sometimes easily cleared or, more often than is probable, the game plays close enough to tempt using boosters, which mostly fall just short of clearing, then drain all boosters and $ until gone. BOOOO...HISSSS... UNINSTALLED...PHHT

Love the game & no ads 😁 but i cant send my family extra cards like ive read other players Reviews, I'm kind of bummed. I've never been able to do it. Otherwise I love this game, but like another review said, once you get all the power ups, they throw you a super hard level which makes you use them all, so you don't have to spend money although I do spend money occasionally. It's only right everybody needs to make something.

I'm sad. At first I loved this game so much. No ads, lots of power ups, lots of fun events. Then, at higher levels, it becomes ridiculously hard. Yes these types of games are always challenging at some point, but like other people have said, it's just absurd. The difficulty doesn't change progressively, it does so all of a sudden, and I'm not enjoying it anymore because of how many days it takes to solve one level, and events requiring you to pass on your first try everytime... It's ridiculous.

All that's advertised are the puzzles, which is why I downloaded the game. I see one puzzle every 7-12 days. I'm also tired of the push to spend money on levels where the Super Hard ones are the same or easier than other levels. That's where you make your money. I'm looking for other entertainment.

Writing this a THIRD time because my first and second review was taken down without my permission. This is just a match three game. The "save the king" advertisements are fake. There are challenges where you save him, but it's just rapidly matching a lot of tiles in under a minute and not the challenges in the advertisements, which is disappointing. Other than that, it's fun to play, but annoyed about the fake ads.

When I play Candy Crush and run out of moves, the on board power ups I didn't get the chance to use get used automatically to further your odds of beating a level. This game doesn't do that. Nothing's more frustrating than having a board full of power ups and running out of moves, being forced to the game over screen.

This games started off really fun and addictive. Then, it started getting more difficult, but with some perseverance it remained fun. Now they have increased the difficulty level again. You'll need to spend coins almost every level to keep going. Once I finish my coins I'll bet putting this game away. Too bad because it could be a lot of fun if not for greed.

Started out VERY fun, but seems it has changed a LOT over the past month or so.. No combos anymore, the booster you use blows up everything now or for sure your light ball no matter how far away. Often you'll get down to 1 item left, so that you buy coins or boosters to get it.. It's OFTEN taking 3-4-5 days to clear a REGULAR level and this was not the case when I joined several months ago. Costing way too much and games should be FUN not challenging for DAYS!

It's fun, at first. I'm repulsed by the greedy-grabby way that it's made to work, though. Uninstalling it because I don't have unlimited $$$, and playing one level repeatedly for a week to finish--unless I spend money for extra moves--isn't really that much fun.

*** Updated review bc they have changed the algorithm making it impossible to beat levels unless you pay. AND they have changed all of the "packages" you can buy from $2.99 to now $19.99. AND when you pay, all of the sudden you win level after level then BOOM, 900 coins for the last 5 moves....and you do that...the suddenly the coins you bought are gone after a few levels. I have to give it to the games developers. It's highly addictive and you will spend serious $$$.

For a game that claims not to have any ads it certainly has a million ads in every other game. This is so freaking annoying. Also, the false advertising is getting freaking old, and like on every freaking online "free" game, you have to spend money to advance. Just don't waste your time.

Played on and off for about a month and on 700 plus levels. Beginner levels are easy as expected to hook you in. Later levels are more challenging. Alot of fun. Taking part in the challenges are rewarding and helps quicker progression. Some levels are just mean and just take perseverance. Tip for those frustrated and always low on coins. Always keep a stash unused for events as completion and progression is more rewarding. Some levels you will inevitably fail until you get some luck. Keep at it.

Quite addictive game, excellent graphics. Has in app purchases that add tools that help beat the levels. However it is not necessary to buy anything to complete the various stages and there are lots. I have made a few small purchases mainly because I feel the developers deserve rewarding for their efforts for giving me hours of fun.

Fun for a while. You can breeze through the 1st 100 levels in no time, and you will amass a lot of coins and power ups that you'll never have to really use until...about level 150 there is a HUGE increase in absurd difficulty. You have 25 moves, you have to clear 40 vases that take 2 hits to clear, 5 safes that take 4 hits to clear, but before that you have to remove 30 red and 30 yellow to even uncover those. It takes 1 move to create a power up and then another move to activate the power up

This game started off fantastically: I leveled up quickly and decided to have a minor investment so to have enough credits in case I would not be able to complete a level on the first try. I really like playing this game, but now that I managed to get to level 196 after having bought several times more credits along the way, the game is conceived in such a way that you are hardly able to complete a stage on the first try. Quickly this game is becoming a pay-to-win game that drains your wallet.

This is not pay to play, it's a nice game. I'm on 1700 and didn't spend anything (probably will to support the developers). Some levels are difficult (not the red or purple ones), but that's because the game algorithm doesn't want to let me pass levels that will complete some reward goals. There are many free lives and many rewards, the gameplay is pleasant for the most part. Unless some major change happens (ads between levels) I'll keep playing.

Not so bad,but I lose the interest in the game pretty quickly. You don't have an option to choose the castle and decorations and more. Shame really would a bit more fun, and not this monotone to get stars, it just gets boring after a bit. Lv getting harder that you need to use the tools bit later you need to spend money. Not for me when i can't even choose what pillar or trees i want.

Fun game, although it's added so many mini games within the game it's ALMOST like waiting for an ad to finish. Also I want to start over but can't. It says "You can either tap on the "Contact Us" button located at the top right corner of the screen or tap on "No" down below the screen and tap on "Contact Us." When the chat window appears, please write “Delete my account.” But none of these solutions are actually in the game. A little annoyed

So, I have now "qualified" for Royal League and can no longer play it unless I "complete all the areas" which will take all the stars I have worked so hard to accumulate over 10k levels? I sure hope you rethink this because if this doesn't change, I'll have to stop playing. Actually, I can't play now anyway because your game will no longer allow me to. Please change this. I would really like to keep playing this game.

I really enjoy this game, especially because I'm on an active team, but 2 things drive me nuts: 1. when special bombs are distributed everywhere on the board except where they're needed (often the case), and 2. that multiple bombs do the same damage as a single bomb. If three bombs go off in the same area, they should do the damage of three bombs!

The adverts make this game look so different. It's such a shame that the adverts are entirely false. It's just another gardenscapes. The Kings nightmare should be the entire game. That would have guven you a real edge. Shame devs just followed what everyone else is doing. But yeah actual gameplay is 99% not what the ads show. :/

Stuck on a level for four days, wasted dozens of lives and boosts trying to beat it. It's not even a "hard" level, that labeling system sucks anyway. Shouldn't have to use extra moves to beat a level. Total money grab game. Unfortunately i paid too much to play already. Uninstalling now.

I'm a fan of Homescapes and Lily's Garden, so I thought it would be fun to decorate a castle. But I quickly found that I don't get to pick and choose what decorations adorn the the castle. It's all pre-chosen. You just play levels, acquire stars, and move on to the next task. There's no story, no character development, and no originality. I can't do hundreds of levels of boring, if the entire game is going to be like this. I WILL say that the animation is good and the absence of ads is a plus.

This game is terrible you can't win without running out of lives. I got so frustrated with this game. Every level you have use or buy powerups to win every level. Who ever invented this game is money hungry. Delete and never want to play this game unless they fix where you can win some levels without paying and running out of lives too fast. What a nice game but a waste of time.

This game looked very fun before I got it, I've been playing this game for a "VERY LONG TIME" now and I have "NOT" once been able to try to save THE KING in any situation. Before i downloaded this game i've only seen ads for it and demo's about it. "EVERY TIME" it was advertised it would show THE KING in some kind of distress where he needed to be saved.. that's the part that looked very fun and challenging.. "DOES IT EVER GET TO THAT POINT???" I want to save The King and have some fun!!

Simply a clickbait game, where you're lured through the levels where you have to save the king, but, it ends u with innumerable matching games just like candy crush. And the ratio of saving the king levels and normal colour matching levels are just 1:100. The graphics are a bit better. But, I'm not here for better graphics, I'm here to play the save the king episodes. I am uninstalling it.

It's a great game no doubt. No ads , just as it advertises. However, After playing for a few weeks it becomes obvious there are no skills involved. The game decides when you go to the next level, you have no say, unless you are willing to buy additional packages. Before you know it, you are spending heaps of money just to collect cards and move up a few levels. I did the rational thing and uninstalled the game before spending more money.

I enjoy playing the game but when I see it advertised it shows various mini games of rescuing the king. I've played over 300 levels and not seen this rescuing Saga once. Why hasn't the game been updated so advertising reflects what is in the game. Endless matching and just a few Kings Nightmare puzzles. Not worth continuing.

I was really enjoying this game until, I reached a level that literally can't be beat. Used every power up I had and bought coins too and for 2 weeks and I've tried to no avail. I refuse to spend anymore $ which is what it seems their trying to force me to do to advance. I uninstalled, too many other games I can play.

The game is fun to play, and I do enjoy some of the challenging levels, but how challenging should levels be? It clearly is becoming a pay to win game. At times, I get stuck on one level for 2 days and it can get very frustrating knowing that you won't be able to beat the level without purchasing powerups, or just keep playing until the game has decided to give you everything you need to beat a level you've been playing for nearly 48 hours. Levels get harder, rewards are still the same SMH

Fun game until you get to level 200. Every level after that is nearly impossible to beat. It's a matching game and takes 20 to 50 tries to beat one level. You can't get any rewards because you didn't beat the level the first try. Without purchases, it's a complete waste of time. Don't even bother.

Its become too hard to complete the level , some time feel that some one not give properly steps to play the game , its not so joyful to play the game , the player feel borious become its level not completed , so my suggestion to the team that gives proper chance to complete thr game, one more thing about game that if you buy then its become easy too.

What a ridiculous game ! Super easy at the beginning but extremely hard later on. I uninstalled it as without spending your real money you can't pass the level. Such a shame !! People should be ashamed of themselves as everything is about money these days ! Even the games. Great graphics, no adds but the fact that you have to waste your money is stupid. Don't waste time on this game.

Had to change rating from 5 to 1 star. It used to be fun playing this game but now it's seems like the only way to pass a level is to invest money. It has gone from a fun way to pass time to a very frustrating game, the levels are way harder after you pass 10k levels and the number of moves you get is ridiculous I used to play it daily now I just play when the Dragon Events come on

The game is fun to play BUT it takes allot of tries to complete each level which doesn't bother me. What does bother me is that there are 5 lives and after that you can't play until a considerable amount of time has passed. Make this game better by getting rid of the lives. Play each level for how ever many tries it takes. You can go through 5 lives in less than 10 minutes. Very frustrating.

This is a typical match 3 game. Some levels are challenging. Overall this game is great; it has smooth game play and no ads. Help decorate the castle as you progress through the levels. The "save the King" levels appear periodically as the King's nightmares. These can be skipped if you choose.

Fun, good artstyle, But the odds never stop stacking against you. Levels get more difficult, new items get introduced that make playing harder, but you're still using the same 4 or 5 powerups since the very beginning. Pretty difficult and paying 900 coins for 5 lives is a bit of a scam. Still pretty fun though. Also, if 2 bombs detonate next to an item, it should take two ticks of damage. Lightning ball + tnt is so much worse than lightning ball + heli or rockets in my opinion because of this

BEST. MATCH. GAME. EVER. Exclamation point. And no ads whatsoever. Of course there are extra helpers available for purchase, but it is totally unnecessary to spend a dime in order to advance. I love the constant special events in the game that make it even more enjoy and addictive. The prizes are fantastic. I haven't had any problems with the game- no freezing, stalling, restarting, losing my data, etc. Great graphics. A big THANK YOU to the developers for this game! Great for all ages.

0 stars - level 8600+ suddenly all 3 booster types disappear (~100 each) Support was useless and condescending - telling me how to save them not address that the ones I had disappeared. Claimed I somehow had used them even though I have kept this many for the past 1-2k levels. Time to uninstall and find another game NOT from dream(nightmare)games. They can go ..... themselves....

No ads but gradually forces you to rely on items to progress. Around level 180 I noticed that it was almost impossible to beat a level without the use of items or purchasing extra moves. Which is a shame as I was enjoying the game. I would even welcome the option to watch an ad to reward extra moves rather than purchasing.

Wahoo the new collection game is top notch. But my problem was that I already had 500 plus I was chasing 1000 before the game finished I lost that one just like that. I thought maybe they could me the chance to open it. Honestly this game has reduced my thinking in fact I found Joy in it. Very interesting and very addictive it keeps your mind at Rest all the time. I love love it

played it for a bit, very boring. its just clicking on random colors, and the ads are false advertising. the game doesnt even let you think, if you wait more than 5 seconds to try and solve it in your head, it just tells you what to do. bored me outta my mind after a few minutes. woulr give it a 0 star rating if i could.

What makes this game fun? There are no ads and the developer is not pushy. The levels are easy and at the same time, tricky. Not boring, and you have to think well before you spend your gold coins because there is no getting back on levels, you can't farm coins. The powerups are relatively cheap, unlike some games which get very expensive boosters.

meh. I just completed level 15 and so far it's just the same thing over and over. new power ups are added. new obstacles are added. fairly deceiving, as the gameplay in the video ads featured on other games shows what appears to be a bonus round. so far I have only been able to play one bonus round

It's definitely a fun game, however, requires too many stars to build a level. On top of that, you don't even get to choose what you would like in an area, so the amount of stars required does not equate. If you really want to play and pass levels, prepare to spend $$$, which is the whole point for the game creators! 🤣🤷🏾‍♀️😕

well it was five stars until they started cutting the rewards. Dragon quest used to be 5000 coins and now mission control and magic cauldron only 500 instead of 1000. Please don't become a pay to win.(Edit: it's a pay to win, the game is horrible now, they cut rewards and made levels almost impossible to win, trying to get you to spend money)

I don't play many games, but this 1 definitely has my full attention! Pretty addictive & fun! However, after you play a hard level & the next level "isn't supposed to be hard," it's harder than the level that was hard! I know there are no ads, but how they have the levels set up must be so we can purchase boosters. Nonetheless, I enjoy the game just make these levels make sense.

Relatively fun until you get to levels that are designed to make you lose. From there, you either spend money to keep from losing a streak or you're stuck on it for the the next three days. Even if you have enough coins to get through that level, it is almost always certain you'll face the same problem next level. Like I said, relatively fun and easy, but blatantly aggravating that that's how it works.

Fun enough game, but unless you are willing to spend money after a certain level, you will have to play levels MANY times to beat them. Also if you spend money on this app, you may find fraudulent charges on your card as I did. And for an app that claims no ads, their over 1 minute ads on other games should scream "Stay away!" to you.

I downloaded to do the save the king puzzles. But of course these puzzles only show up after you complete 10 or 20 other Candy crush levels. I got to about 250 levels and then got bored and uninstalled. As you get into the higher levels, the puzzles get more difficult until you peel out your wallet. Meh

I have NEVER spent $$ on a game until this one...figured it would make a difference and the makers mite appreciate those dedicated to it? Although it's hard to stay dedicated when the obvious lures to advance become based on the $$ your willing to spend. I refuse to spend any more $$ let's see were that gets me?? A game should be Fair for All not just those pumping cash into it. Im most likely to stick with it a bit longer bcuz it Does have Alot of features I like!! We'll see...?

If you want a normal match-3 game, go for it. But the ads promised me a different game, where you match-3 and help save the king from various stuff, which is there but it's only there once every 5 (or more) levels. I'm currently at level 15 and I've got only one such level till now. I don't get why developers advertise the game as something it's not. Like, if you are advertising one game, have the guts to make that game the whole game. You clearly can make such games, given that one level.

Absolutely love this game, been playing it since 2020 or so and never got bored or disappointed with it. There are always new and interesting challenges and unlike most match-3 type games here there are elements where you actually need to think and make a strategy, not just mindless tapping/swiping. I like the style very much, it's cartoonish but in a very likeable, fun and cute way, not too over-"sugarized" like other games like this. And also, yes it actually has ABSOLUTELY NO ADS whatsoever!

This is both a great and terrible game, and emphasizes the pros and cons of both. At about level 1500 it seems like skill is removed and you just have to luck into winning levels. As several mini games depend on winning consecutive levels, it does feel like the game forces you to pay to win. Having said that, I've not spent a dime, there are no ads, and you can manage to occasionally go on a winning streak if you bank and spend your power-ups at the right time. A good time waster, I guess.

Butler's Gift.... I hate that you lose you Gifts after failing a level one time. I've been playing for 2 weeks and I'm on level 597 that's how much I enjoy playing this game. However some levels especially the super hard level doesn't give enough moves at ALLLLLLLLLL it's as if it knows when when you have lots and not enough coins in order to PLAY ON

Fantastic Game! I actually beat the game and am sad. It stops at a little over 2600 levels. It does take money to pass some of the levels but they have a lot of low affordable bundles. The graphics are cool. They incorporate new items to the levels to keep the game interesting. You can request lives from teammates instead of having to wait for them to refill. It's actually one of my favorite games.

Have been playing this game for a while now, then decided to read reviews. If it were possible to give a minus start rating for bad games this would get a minus 5 star. Game is bias, power ups don't appear when you've earned them and I see the developers have taken away the ability to communicate with them over game errors. Don't bother playing, I'm deleting it.

Escellent game. Quick response from tech support. My boosters disappeared but they restored it in just a few minutes! Levels become more difficult but it's a strategy game so I don't mind. Yes it gets more difficult as you advance but it does ease up more often than you would expect. Keep up the good work! Cheers!

Was put off by gameplay videos showing that it isn't like the ads but then tried it anyway because I like Royal Kingdom, and it is a lot more similar to that actually, just different effects. The negative point is that it doesn't allow me to select my correct Google account to save (it just acts like I have one, which is not the one I'm saving on and was also not current on any other apps so no idea why it chose that one and has no option to change which one).

The game play starts out fun. Eventually you reach a point where the only challenge is incredibly tight starting space which negates the usefulness of starting rewards entirely and later skilled plays drastically, essentially forcing you to buy coins to gain extra rounds. I got to level 244 and the game has become massively unfun unless you continue to dump money into it.

False Advertising. I was seeing this game advertised on another game and it looked fun, so I downloaded it. The advertising showed saving a king from dangerous situations, but it was just another match 3 game with an occasional special save the king scenario. I played for about 15 minutes and then deleted it.

Great game to help pass the time and relax. I've reached points where every time you complete an area, you go into the Royal League where every level is hard or super hard and have to wait 2 weeks for new levels. Which only ends up being 1 area and right back to the Royal League. Still like the game, but wish they'd develop more than 1 area at a time.

I went to check Royal Match after I saw its ads in another game, and it definitely exceeded expectations. High quality art, smooth animation, and no annoying ads to interrupt your experience. In terms of fairness and rewards, it's still early for me to say, but I hope it's more like Lily's Garden and less like Homescapes. Those in the know will understand.

After over 1000 levels, this game cheats! I still play it but it will literally let you use your last move to send a bomb and propeller to beat the level and it intentionally goes to the wrong place. Every other time it does what it's supposed to do. I still play it because it's addictive. Biggest leg down was spending coins and power ups to win the Lava Quest, expecting to win 10,000 coins among other players and we end up SHARING it 🙄

Great game with no ads. I was wondering how they make their money. Well... at level 550, the levels are now so hard, that I have to pay for it to be fun (lives run out, and you can only play for 10 mins or so without powerups and such). I mean, they gave me days and days of awesome free play, so I'm not complaining, but I get how they make money now. I have bought a couple small packages, but I wish they were better value.

I am really disappointed in this game cuz the king's nightmare doesn't really come very often. And the free items to start your level with is really a waste of free items since you are given no choice but to use all of them within your first two moves every level. So to make it more challenging every fourth level I purposely lose so I can start each level over and earn the free items all over again. Cuz getting all of them all the time ends up really hitting you at the end of the level

Gets too challenging too soon i.e. total moves given to clear each level quickly becomes too little. Season Pass is excessive at 11.99 and no point getting if can anticipate each and every level is a potential struggle to clear. Extremely similar to Toon Blast but much more expensive and less rewarding. PS. You're not the only game in existence with no ads!

It started out as a good game. I marked it down so much because it very quickly got to a point where the only way forward is purchase extra moves or power ups. They advertise that they have no ads - and they don't - they just constantly ask you to buy extras for the game. Very annoying. Uninstalled.

Haven't downloaded nor played this game and never will because the Royal Match ads appear way too frequently (very annoying and intrusive) on other app games. Wish they would take the target off my back! Their ads are way too long, almost 2 minutes long. There should be a rule of app ads limited to only 30 seconds max.

I give royal match Five stars. This game is fun, not to hard to play, and it is as free. That is part I like most about it, because when you play there are no ad breaks and when you get to half way through each area there is a mini game where you have to save the king is an certain amount time and if was easy to complete. overall I really like this game it is free, ad free, and lots fun. I encourage everyone to download this game and play it is a lot of fun, try it now.

I got this game to play the challenges displayed in the ads. I'm at level 272 & have done maybe 5 of those. At this point in order to win a level, I need boosters to win or coins to continue playing to win and even then, it's a hit or miss. It's a very redundant game and I've gotten bored after a couple of weeks. Keep in mind, you will be encouraged to independently purchase boosters, coins, hearts, etc. You can get hearts from a team but all things credited within the game is slow to get.

I enjoy the game and have almost made it to level 500 without spending real money, so it CAN be done. My ONLY complaint is that lives take entirely too long to regenerate, 25 minutes is a bit much, and it would be awesome to see that time decreased just a bit. Also, "save the King" drew me, but he hasn't been saved by me that often 🤣. Great game overall.

I am encountering more and more levels that are very hard to get through without spending money. It seems that unless I want to spend a lot of money or a lot of time on this game, I will probably stop playing before too long. Entertaining simple game that I enjoy. There are in-app purchases available, but they are NOT needed to enjoy this game. The game releases frequent specials or events that will help you when stuck on a level. Also, I'd recommend joining a team to get help with more lives (don't need to bug your real friends on Facebook! Lol). This game is most similar to Candy Crush (difference is Royal Match feels like there are many more features to help a player).

Too many "super hard" levels. 6 stars just to display a crown? When one doesn't have boosters on hard levels and all our 5 lives are gone, the temptation is to go download another game. It would be awesome if you replaced them with real thrills such as more King's Nightmares. Otherwise, the idea of decorating a castle is exciting; many of the background music are great; the organisation of levels into Areas and the clear indication of the percentage progress are nice features.

Fun little game at first, but once you get above level 200 a lot of the levels are ridiculously hard. Made it to level 249 and spent over a week trying it. Don't think it was possible for me without spending money so uninstalled.

I've been playing this game for quite a while now and it's fun, addicting, and challenging. I'm almost to level 10000. However, the ads are misleading, what they show are sections that you only get once in a while. And while it is totally free some of the super hard levels I could only beat after making a purchase to get the equipment and coins to continue. However when you join a team you can earn coins by helping your teammates but that takes time to build up coins needed.

The stage difficulty hits a brick wall at some point and just starts screwing you over because it does not know how else to slow you down. That's not fun

Agree with some other reviews. The algorithm has changed here. The power ups no longer complete rhe next best move. It will destroy any other power ups you may have. Not sure if it's trying to slow people down but it's a turn off. And I am on level 3900+

Those who can not play the game are blaming it on the developers. You don't need to purchase any power-ups or such to complete levels. It is all up to your thinking capabilities. I'm in level 8301 ( the highest level so far), and i didn't spend a single dime on this game. If you are not good with puzzles, don't blame it on the game. It's all on you! Must spend to win. Basic match 3 gameplay. Only interesting parts are the "save the king" scenarios but they are too difficult to pass unless you pay for aids. Also...please change the king's voice in your ads. It pops up at you and it's sooooo annoying!

Fantastic!! It's easy, even in later levels, though they mix it up. Powerups are usually free as you complete levels. The best part?? The ads for this game Match The Gameplay. However, when the developers realized that this strategy was allowing players to progress more easily, they removed it. As a result, I lost all 60k coins in a month.

It may not innovate, but the art is charming and suggests some passion. This offers a lot of fun content without wasting your time. A+
